title: Prospective multicenter feasibility study of omnipolar near-field peak-frequency mapping for slow-pathway localization in typical atrioventricular nodal re-entrant tachycardia.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Slow-pathway (SP) ablation is the established therapy for atrioventricular nodal re-entrant tachycardia (AVNRT). While conventional anatomical and electrogram-guided approaches are effective, SP localization may be challenging in a subset of procedures. Omnipolar near-field (OTNF) peak frequency (PF) mapping has been proposed as a signal-based approach to support SP localization; however, prospective multicenter data remain limited.

METHODS: Fifty consecutive adults with inducible typical AVNRT underwent catheter ablation in three Italian hospitals. High-density right atrial mapping was performed during sinus rhythm using a 16-pole grid catheter (Advisor™ HD Grid) with OTNF on the EnSite X system. PF maps were generated (high-frequency threshold > 250 Hz), and RF applications were delivered to the region of highest PF. Voltage maps were also created to delineate low-voltage bridge (LVB) regions (typically 0.04-2 mV) for retrospective overlap/localization analyses; LVB was not used to select ablation targets.

RESULTS: Acute procedural success was achieved in all patients, with no procedural complications. The effective ablation site (junctional beats with subsequent SP modification and/or non-inducibility) corresponded to the highest PF region in 45/50 patients (90%). In a retrospective overlap/localization analysis, the effective site fell within the LVB region in 36/50 patients (72%); concordance between PF-defined and LVB-defined regions at the effective site was observed in 35/50 patients (70%). Mean PF in the SP target region was 424 ± 86 Hz versus 272 ± 57 Hz in surrounding tissue (P < 0.05 on paired testing). Exploratory ROC analysis yielded an AUC of 0.937 with an optimal cutoff of 357 Hz (sensitivity 0.87; specificity 0.94); these estimates should be interpreted cautiously because PF guided RF target selection (incorporation/target-selection bias).

CONCLUSION: In this prospective multicenter cohort, OTNF-derived PF mapping was feasible and reproducibly identified a discrete region used to guide SP ablation in typical AVNRT. ROC-derived thresholds and performance estimates are exploratory and require independent validation in cohorts where ablation targets are not selected using PF criteria.

title: Premature ventricular contractions: pathophysiology, prognostic impact, and management.
summary: Premature ventricular contractions (PVCs) arise from an early depolarization originating in either of the cardiac ventricles. They are common in individuals both with and without structural heart disease, although their true prevalence remains uncertain. Several electrophysiological mechanisms can initiate the PVC, with re-entry being the most frequent. The detection of PVCs should prompt a thorough clinical evaluation to identify potential underlying cardiac disease, yet many PVCs ultimately prove to be idiopathic. In individuals with established structural heart disease, PVCs have been associated with a poorer prognosis; however, clinical trials aimed at suppressing PVCs in this population have not demonstrated improved outcomes. In contrast, the prognostic significance of PVCs in patients without structural heart disease remains unclear. Factors such as PVC burden, PVC morphology, and cardiac magnetic resonance findings have been proposed as prognostic markers, although the evidence is still debated. In general, patients without structural heart disease and with a low PVC burden can be reassured regarding their prognosis. Treatment is primarily guided by symptoms, although reducing PVC burden may be considered even in asymptomatic individuals to mitigate the risk of complications such as PVC-induced cardiomyopathy or PVC-triggered sustained ventricular arrhythmias. Antiarrhythmic drugs are commonly used as first-line therapy, and the choice of medication should take into account patient characteristics, suspected pathophysiology, and PVC features. Catheter ablation (CA) is more effective than pharmacologic therapy in reducing or eliminating PVCs and may be considered as a first-line option in specific situations where rapid PVC suppression is desired. As an invasive procedure, CA carries potential risks that must be weighed carefully. Operator experience, PVC origin, anatomical considerations, and patient preference all play important roles in decision-making. Further research is needed to better identify patients at risk and to target specific pathophysiological mechanisms. Advances in device-based, patient-driven arrhythmia monitoring and the integration of artificial intelligence are likely to influence future PVC diagnostics and risk stratification.

title: Cerebral Safety of Two Pulsed Field Ablation Workflows for Pulmonary Vein Isolation: Results From the Randomized TWOSOME MRI Study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Data on silent cerebral events/lesions (SCE/SCL) following pulsed field ablation (PFA) for pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) are limited. This study aimed to assess the incidence of SCE/SCL using cerebral magnetic resonance imaging (cMRI) in atrial fibrillation (AF) patients undergoing PVI with two distinct PFA systems and workflows.

METHODS: In this prospective, single-center TWOSOME MRI substudy, patients with paroxysmal AF were randomized 1:1 to single-shot or single-tip PFA. Single-shot PVI was performed using a pentaspline PFA catheter (single-transseptal access, PV-angiography, no 3D mapping) and single-tip PVI using a PFA generator with a focal ablation catheter (double-transseptal access, 3D mapping). A predefined consecutive cohort underwent 1.5-T cMRI 24 h after the procedure. SCE were defined as acute cMRI-detected lesions resolving on 6-week follow-up cMRI, and SCL as persistent lesions. Baseline characteristics, neurological symptoms, procedural data, and cMRI findings were assessed.

RESULTS: Fifty patients underwent cMRI (25 per group). Acute SCE were detected in 3/50 patients (6%; 95% CI 1.3-16.5), with 1/25 (4%) in the single-shot group and 2/25 (8%) in the single-tip group (p = 1.00). All SCE resolved on follow-up imaging, with no evidence of persistent SCL. One symptomatic stroke occurred in the single-shot group, unrelated to PFA, and was attributed to air embolization during transseptal puncture. No permanent neurological deficits occurred.

CONCLUSIONS: In this exploratory cMRI study, both PFA workflows showed a low incidence of SCE without evidence of SCL or PFA-related neurological complications. Larger studies are required to compare cerebral safety profiles of PFA technologies.

TRIAL REGISTRATION: NCT07175727 (clinicaltrials.gov).

title: Cavotricuspid Isthmus Ablation Using a Variable Loop Pulsed Field Ablation Catheter: A Single-Center Descriptive Analysis.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Cavotricuspid isthmus (CTI) ablation is frequently performed concomitant with pulmonary vein isolation (PVI). Pulsed field ablation (PFA) has emerged as the preferred energy source for PVI, but it is unclear whether CTI ablation can be performed with PFA catheters.

METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed data from patients who underwent PVI and CTI ablation using a variable-loop PFA catheter for feasibility, efficacy, and safety.

RESULTS: Twenty-three patients (mean age 65 years, 57% male) were included in this analysis. Systemic intravenous nitroglycerin was administered to all subjects to prevent vasospasm. Acute CTI block could be documented in all patients at the end of the ablation procedure without complications and with low fluoroscopy exposure. We observed one symptomatic recurrence of possible typical atrial flutter during a mean follow-up of 218 days.

CONCLUSION: CTI ablation using a variable-loop PFA ablation catheter was feasible, efficient, and safe in the acute setting. Prospective studies with larger patient numbers are needed to evaluate the long-term efficacy and safety of this approach.

title: Coupling Interval Variability of Outflow Tract Premature Ventricular Contractions: A Poincaré Plot-Based Assessment.
summary:
PURPOSE: Coupling interval variability (ΔCI) of premature ventricular contractions (PVCs) may provide insight into their site of origin. This study evaluated whether ΔCI, quantified by Poincaré graph analysis, can distinguish PVCs arising from the right ventricular outflow tract (RVOT) compared to other locations.

METHODS: We screened 117 patients undergoing electroanatomical mapping and catheter ablation for PVCs. Exclusion criteria included: failed ablation, low PVC burden on Holter ECG, non-sinus baseline rhythm, or absence of a qualifying Holter recording. Sixty patients met these criteria: 34 with RVOT PVCs, 11 with left ventricular outflow tract (LVOT) PVCs, and 15 with non-RVOT PVCs. ΔCI was assessed using Poincaré plots derived from the Holter ECG recordings.

RESULTS: A ΔCI < 100 ms predicted RVOT origin with a specificity of 100% and a sensitivity of 25%. Poincaré plots effectively visualized CI variability, with narrow PVC clusters (measured along the x-axis) corresponding to RVOT origin. Broader clusters were observed in LVOT and other non-RVOT PVCs, reflecting greater variability.

CONCLUSIONS: ΔCI, represented by Poincaré plots, is a reliable and time-efficient marker of RVOT PVC origin. Narrow PVC clusters with low ΔCI strongly suggest RVOT localization, offering a practical adjunct to vectographic mapping in clinical ablation strategies.

title: Investigating the TASK1 potassium channel in equine atrial myocardium as a potential treatment target for atrial fibrillation.
summary:
BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is the most common clinically relevant arrhythmia in horses, with limited pharmacological treatment options in both veterinary and human medicine. TASK1 potassium channels represent a promising atrial-selective antiarrhythmic target, but their relevance in horses has not been established. To characterize equine TASK1 (eqTASK1) channels regarding structural conservation, electrophysiological function, pharmacological sensitivity, cardiac expression pattern and in vivo electrophysiological effects of TASK1 inhibition.

EXPERIMENTAL APPROACH: Sixteen horses killed for non-cardiovascular reasons, of which 10 horses used for tissue harvesting and six horses for in vivo testing. Functional and pharmacological properties of eq TASK1 and human (hTASK1) channels were assessed in Xenopus laevis oocytes using two-electrode voltage clamp recordings. Cardiac expression of eqTASK1 was analysed by qRT-PCR and immunoblotting, while in vivo electrophysiological studies were performed in anaesthetized horses before and after intravenous ketodoxapram administration.

KEY RESULTS: EqTASK1 and h TASK1 channels demonstrated high structural conservation, comparable potassium-selective background currents and preserved pharmacological sensitivity with species-dependent differences in potency. EqTASK1 expression was strongly enriched in atrial and nodal tissue, whereas ventricular expression was minimal. In vivo administration of ketodoxapram significantly prolonged atrial effective refractory periods from 275 ± 54 to 418 ± 94 ms without significant changes in heart rate or atrioventricular conduction parameters.

CONCLUSION AND IMPLICATIONS: EqTASK1 channels are highly conserved with human orthologs and display pronounced atrial-predominant cardiac expression. In vivo TASK1 inhibition prolongs atrial refractoriness in horses, supporting TASK1 as a translational atrial-selective antiarrhythmic target in both human and veterinary medicine.

AI.motivation: 房颤是马最常见的临床相关心律失常，兽医和人类医学中药物治疗选择均有限。TASK1钾通道是潜在的心房选择性抗心律失常靶点，但其在马中的相关性尚未确立。
AI.method: 研究纳入16匹非心血管原因死亡的马，其中10匹用于组织取材，6匹用于在体测试。在非洲爪蟾卵母细胞中采用双电极电压钳记录评估马TASK1（eqTASK1）与人TASK1（hTASK1）通道的功能和药理特性；通过qRT-PCR和免疫印迹分析eqTASK1的心脏表达；在麻醉马中于静脉给予ketodoxapram前后进行在体电生理研究。
AI.result: eqTASK1与hTASK1通道结构高度保守，具有可比的钾选择性背景电流和保留的药理敏感性，但效力存在种属差异。eqTASK1表达在心房和结组织强烈富集，心室表达极低。在体给予ketodoxapram后，心房有效不应期从275 ± 54 ms显著延长至418 ± 94 ms，心率和房室传导参数无显著变化。
AI.conclusion: eqTASK1通道与人类同源物高度保守，并呈现显著的心房优势表达。在体抑制TASK1可延长马心房不应期，支持TASK1作为人类和兽医医学中可转化的心房选择性抗心律失常靶点。

title: Coffee and the Risk of Atrial Fibrillation
summary: Most hospitals and cardiac rehabilitation facilities provide decaffeinated coffee to cardiac patients in place of regular coffee. Recent studies, however, suggest that coffee drinking may decrease the risk of developing cardiovascular diseases. Review of controlled studies shows that drinking regular coffee in moderation is safe. It may even lead to a decrease in atrial arrhythmias such as atrial fibrillation, and it is safe in patients with ventricular arrhythmias. This is particularly true in patients who drink coffee regularly and in moderation. Energy drinks, however, that contain large doses of caffeine may indeed be harmful and should be avoided. The policies of serving only decaffeinated coffee in hospitals and rehabilitation facilities should be revisited.

AI.tldr: 适量饮用常规咖啡可能降低房颤等房性心律失常风险，且对室性心律失常患者安全，医院应重新考虑仅提供无咖啡因咖啡的政策。

AI.method: 本文为综述，回顾了关于咖啡饮用与心律失常风险的对照研究，评估常规咖啡（适量）对房性心律失常（如房颤）和室性心律失常的影响，并提及能量饮料中高剂量咖啡因的潜在危害。摘要未报告具体样本量、终点定义及统计方法。

AI.conclusion: 适量常规咖啡对心律失常患者安全且可能降低房颤风险，医院及康复机构仅提供无咖啡因咖啡的政策应重新审视；但证据来自综述，缺乏定量数据，需进一步前瞻性研究验证。

Quality of life after cryoballoon vs. radiofrequency ablation in atrial fibrillation: a subanalysis of the FREEZE cohort study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Catheter ablation for symptomatic atrial fibrillation (AF) is an established treatment, with cryoballoon (CBA) and radiofrequency ablation (RFA) showing similar success rates. However, comparative data on health-related quality of life (HRQoL) outcomes between these methods are limited. This study compares HRQoL changes following CBA vs. RFA in symptomatic AF patients.

METHODS: This sub-analysis of the FREEZE Cohort Study (NCT01360008) compared HRQoL outcomes between CBA (group A) and RFA (group B) using the EQ-5D-3L questionnaire and EHRA symptom scores at baseline and follow-up. Changes in mobility, self-care, usual activities, pain/discomfort, anxiety/depression, EQ-VAS, and general physical condition (GPC) were assessed.

RESULTS: Between 2011 and 2016, 4,189 patients were included, with 2,110 (50.4%) completing all HRQoL questionnaires. The mean age was 61.8 ± 10.4 years, with 39.2% female patients. Group A had a higher proportion of patients with paroxysmal AF (72.8% vs. 65.4%, p < 0.01). Overall complication rates were similar (7.6% vs. 10.1%, p = 0.07). The median follow-up was 434 (375, 517) days. Atrial arrhythmia recurrence was more frequent in group B (45.0% vs. 56.9%, p < 0.0001), as were repeat ablations (7.9% vs. 22.3%, p < 0.001) and rehospitalizations (26.0% vs. 46.7%, p < 0.0001). Both groups experienced significant improvements in HRQoL. After multivariable adjustment, group A remained associated with greater improvement in pain/discomfort (aOR 1.62, 95% CI 1.26-2.08), EQ-VAS (aOR 1.60, 95% CI 1.27-2.02), and the EuroQol 5D-Score (aOR 1.39, 95% CI 1.10-1.76).

CONCLUSION: Both CBA and RFA significantly improved HRQoL. However, CBA was associated with greater improvements in pain/discomfort, EQ-VAS, and the EuroQol 5D-Score, indicating potential differences in selected HRQoL outcomes between ablation modalities.Clinical Trial Registration: NCT01360008.

title: Epicardial adipose tissue in obesity-related heart failure with preserved ejection fraction and atrial fibrillation: mechanisms, imaging, and therapeutic modulation.
summary: Obesity-related heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) and atrial fibrillation (AF) often coexist, but the contribution of epicardial adipose tissue (EAT) to their overlap remains uncertain. EAT is anatomically contiguous with the myocardium and can undergo inflammatory, profibrotic and metabolic remodeling in obesity. In HFpEF, greater EAT burden is associated with higher filling pressures and findings compatible with external cardiac restraint; in AF, regional peri-atrial fat is associated with abnormal conduction, fibrosis and ablation outcomes. Human EAT experiments demonstrate local profibrotic signaling, while autonomic interventions involving epicardial fat pads provide procedural evidence that does not isolate adipocyte effects. Recent invasive observations in patients with AF also link CT-defined EAT to atrial pressures and obesity-related HFpEF. Exercise, weight loss and metabolic therapies can change measured cardiac fat, although the relevant compartments and responses vary. CT attenuation is not a direct or uniformly directional measure of EAT inflammation. EAT is therefore a measurable phenotype at the HFpEF-AF interface, with stronger local experimental evidence in AF than in HFpEF. Whether changing EAT itself contributes to clinical benefit beyond systemic weight loss or other treatment effects requires longitudinal studies in patients with both conditions.

AI.tldr: 心外膜脂肪组织（EAT）是肥胖相关HFpEF与AF交互中的可测量表型，局部实验证据在AF中强于HFpEF，但改变EAT本身能否带来临床获益尚需纵向研究。
AI.motivation: 肥胖相关射血分数保留的心力衰竭（HFpEF）与心房颤动（AF）常共存，但心外膜脂肪组织（EAT）在二者重叠中的作用尚不明确，既往证据未能明确EAT是否独立贡献于临床表型。
AI.method: 本文为综述，系统整合EAT在HFpEF与AF中的机制、影像学及治疗调节证据，未报告原始研究样本量、干预措施或终点定义，亦未进行定量统计分析。
AI.result: 摘要未报告定量效应量、95%置信区间或P值。综述指出：HFpEF中EAT负荷增加与充盈压升高及心脏外约束征象相关；AF中区域peri-atrial脂肪与传导异常、纤维化及消融结局相关；人类EAT实验显示局部促纤维化信号，但自主神经干预不能分离脂肪细胞效应；CT定义的EAT与心房压力及肥胖相关HFpEF相关；运动、减重及代谢治疗可改变心脏脂肪，但CT衰减并非EAT炎症的直接或方向一致的测量指标。
AI.conclusion: EAT是HFpEF-AF界面的可测量表型，局部实验证据在AF中强于HFpEF；改变EAT本身是否超越全身减重或其他治疗效应带来临床获益，需在同时患两种疾病的患者中开展纵向研究。对电生理实践而言，EAT影像评估可能有助于风险分层，但当前证据尚不足以支持以EAT为靶点的特异性干预。

summary_zh: 背景：肥胖相关的射血分数保留的心力衰竭（HFpEF）与心房颤动（AF）常共存，但心外膜脂肪组织（EAT）在二者重叠中的作用仍不明确。EAT在解剖上与心肌相邻，在肥胖状态下可发生炎症性、促纤维化及代谢性重塑。在HFpEF中，较大的EAT负荷与较高的充盈压及符合心脏外部约束的表现相关；在AF中，区域性的心房周围脂肪与传导异常、纤维化及消融结局相关。人体EAT实验证实了局部促纤维化信号，而涉及心外膜脂肪垫的自主神经干预提供了操作证据，但并未分离出脂肪细胞效应。近期在AF患者中的侵入性观察也将CT定义的EAT与心房压力及肥胖相关HFpEF联系起来。运动、减重及代谢治疗可改变所测量的心脏脂肪，尽管相关脂肪库及反应存在差异。CT衰减值并非EAT炎症的直接或一致方向性的测量指标。因此，EAT是HFpEF-AF交界处一个可测量的表型，在AF中的局部实验证据强于HFpEF。改变EAT本身是否能在系统性减重或其他治疗效果之外带来临床获益，需要在同时患有这两种疾病的患者中进行纵向研究。

title: SPISE for predicting the presence of atrial fibrillation in patients with coronary artery disease: a comparative analysis with TyG index
Open wavefront ablation terminates rotor-driven atrial fibrillation
Vagal Response and Cough Reflex During Atrial Fibrillation Ablation Under Deep Sedation: A Comparison Across Pulsed Field Ablation Systems.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Pulsed field ablation (PFA) is increasingly used for atrial fibrillation (AF), but device-specific autonomic and respiratory reflex responses remain insufficiently characterized. We aimed to compare vagal responses and cough reflexes among three commercially available PFA systems across individual pulmonary veins and the posterior wall.

METHODS: This retrospective single-center study included 200 consecutive patients who underwent AF ablation with FARAPULSE (n = 83), PULSESELECT (n = 83), or VARIPULSE (n = 34). Vagal response was operationally defined as bradyarrhythmia requiring temporary back-up pacing during energy delivery. Cough reflex was assessed intraprocedurally at the left superior pulmonary vein (LSPV), left inferior pulmonary vein (LIPV), right superior pulmonary vein (RSPV), right inferior pulmonary vein (RIPV), and posterior wall.

RESULTS: Baseline characteristics were generally similar among groups, although heart failure and diabetes mellitus (DM) differed significantly. Overall vagal response rates did not differ among FARAPULSE, PULSESELECT, and VARIPULSE (61.4%, 67.5%, and 58.8%, respectively; p = 0.596). In contrast, overall cough reflex rates differed significantly (75.9%, 91.6%, and 55.9%; p < 0.001), driven by consistently higher rates with PULSESELECT. On logistic regression, male sex, body mass index, and use of PULSESELECT versus FARAPULSE were independently associated with cough reflex.

CONCLUSIONS: Cough reflex was most frequent with PULSESELECT, whereas no significant difference in vagal response was observed among platforms. Recognizing these differences may improve procedural planning, sedation strategy, and prophylactic management during PFA.

AI.tldr: 在深度镇静下房颤PFA消融中，三种PFA系统的迷走反应发生率无显著差异，但PULSESELECT的咳嗽反射发生率显著更高。
AI.motivation: PFA已广泛用于房颤消融，但不同PFA系统对自主神经和呼吸反射的影响尚不明确，缺乏系统比较，影响术中镇静策略和并发症预防。
AI.method: 回顾性单中心研究，纳入200例连续接受PFA房颤消融的患者，分别使用FARAPULSE（n=83）、PULSESELECT（n=83）或VARIPULSE（n=34）。迷走反应定义为能量释放时需临时备用起搏的心动过缓性心律失常；咳嗽反射在左上、左下、右上、右下肺静脉及后壁术中评估。统计方法包括组间比较和logistic回归。
AI.result: 三组总体迷走反应率分别为61.4%、67.5%、58.8%，无显著差异（p=0.596）。总体咳嗽反射率分别为75.9%、91.6%、55.9%，差异显著（p<0.001），PULSESELECT组持续更高。logistic回归显示男性、BMI及使用PULSESELECT（对比FARAPULSE）与咳嗽反射独立相关。
AI.conclusion: PULSESELECT的咳嗽反射发生率最高，而迷走反应在各平台间无显著差异。识别这些差异有助于优化PFA术中方案规划、镇静策略及预防性管理。本研究为回顾性单中心设计，结论需前瞻性多中心验证。

summary_zh:
背景：脉冲场消融（PFA）越来越多地用于心房颤动（AF），但设备特异性的自主神经和呼吸反射反应仍未被充分描述。我们旨在比较三种市售PFA系统在各条肺静脉和后壁的迷走反应和咳嗽反射。

方法：这项回顾性单中心研究连续纳入200例接受AF消融的患者，分别使用FARAPULSE（n = 83）、PULSESELECT（n = 83）或VARIPULSE（n = 34）。迷走反应在操作上定义为能量释放期间需要临时备用起搏的心动过缓。咳嗽反射在术中于左上肺静脉（LSPV）、左下肺静脉（LIPV）、右上肺静脉（RSPV）、右下肺静脉（RIPV）和后壁进行评估。

结果：各组基线特征总体相似，尽管心力衰竭和糖尿病（DM）存在显著差异。FARAPULSE、PULSESELECT和VARIPULSE之间的总体迷走反应率无差异（分别为61.4%、67.5%和58.8%；p = 0.596）。相反，总体咳嗽反射率存在显著差异（75.9%、91.6%和55.9%；p < 0.001），这由PULSESELECT持续较高的发生率所驱动。在逻辑回归中，男性性别、体重指数以及使用PULSESELECT versus FARAPULSE与咳嗽反射独立相关。

结论：咳嗽反射在PULSESELECT中最为频繁，而各平台之间未观察到迷走反应的显著差异。认识到这些差异可能改善PFA期间的流程规划、镇静策略和预防性管理。

title: Massive Left Atrial Thrombosis Shortly After Radiofrequency Catheter Ablation: Implications of Reduced Flow Dynamics Detected by Four-Dimensional Flow Magnetic Resonance Imaging.
summary: A large left atrial (LA) thrombus developed 5 days after repeated ablation for persistent atrial fibrillation despite uninterrupted anticoagulation. The thrombus formed at the previously ablated LA roof, where four-dimensional flow magnetic resonance imaging later showed reduced regional flow velocity, suggesting that persistent local flow stagnation may have contributed to thrombus formation.

AI.tldr: 一例持续性房颤再次射频消融后5天，在持续抗凝下仍于左房顶部消融部位形成巨大血栓，4D flow MRI显示该区域血流速度减低。
AI.motivation: 射频消融后左房血栓通常与抗凝中断或左房机械功能受损相关，但在持续抗凝、常规经食管超声未见异常的情况下仍发生巨大血栓的机制尚不明确；既往对局部血流动力学与血栓形成的关系缺乏在体影像证据。
AI.method: 个案报告（单例）。对象为接受再次射频消融的持续性房颤患者，围术期持续抗凝；消融后5天发现左房巨大血栓，血栓位于既往左房顶部消融区域。随后行四维血流磁共振成像（4D flow MRI）评估局部血流动力学。样本量、终点定义及统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: 血栓于再次消融后第5天形成，位于左房顶部既往消融部位；4D flow MRI显示该区域血流速度减低，提示局部血流停滞持续存在。摘要未报告血栓大小、流速具体数值及抗凝方案细节。
AI.conclusion: 提示即使持续抗凝，消融造成的局部血流淤滞仍可能促发左房血栓，4D flow MRI或有助于识别区域性血流动力学异常的高危部位；但为单例观察，不能推断因果关系，需更大样本验证其对术后抗凝策略与影像监测的指导价值。

summary_zh: 尽管抗凝治疗未中断，在因持续性心房颤动重复消融后5天，仍形成了一个巨大的左心房（LA）血栓。血栓形成于先前消融过的左心房顶部，四维血流磁共振成像随后显示该区域血流速度减低，提示持续的局部血流淤滞可能促进了血栓形成。

title: 2026 Asia Pacific Heart Rhythm Society (APHRS) Guidelines (Part I) on Epidemiology, Detection/Screening and Integrated Patient Care in Atrial Fibrillation.
summary: The 2026 Asia Pacific Heart Rhythm Society (APHRS) Guidelines represent the first comprehensive APHRS guidelines dedicated to the management of atrial fibrillation (AF) and comprise four parts covering epidemiology, detection/screening and integrated care; stroke prevention; rate and rhythm control; and lifestyle risk factor and comorbidity management. Part 1 focuses on epidemiology and integrated care management, integrating contemporary global evidence with data and clinical considerations specific to the Asia-Pacific region. It provides evidence-based and practical recommendations for clinical epidemiology in the region, as well as introduces the need for holistic or integrated care management.

AI.tldr: 2026 APHRS 房颤指南第一部分发布，聚焦亚太地区流行病学、筛查检测与整合式管理，为区域房颤诊疗提供循证推荐。
AI.motivation: 亚太地区房颤负担与欧美存在差异，既往缺乏专门针对该区域的综合性指南，临床实践中筛查策略与整合照护路径不统一。
AI.method: 该文件为 APHRS 首部房颤综合指南的第一部分，基于全球当代证据并结合亚太区域数据与临床实际，围绕流行病学、检测/筛查及整体整合照护提出循证且可操作的推荐；摘要未报告系统评价方法、证据等级体系细节及具体推荐条目数。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体研究数据、效应量、置信区间或 P 值；仅说明指南涵盖区域临床流行病学推荐，并引入整体/整合照护管理的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 该指南强调以整合照护模式管理房颤，对亚太地区筛查与长期管理具有实践指导意义；但摘要未提供具体推荐强度与证据水平，需查阅全文获取可操作细节。

summary_zh: 2026年亚太心律学会（APHRS）指南是APHRS首部专门针对心房颤动（AF）管理的综合性指南，由四个部分组成，涵盖流行病学、检测/筛查与整合管理；卒中预防；心率与节律控制；以及生活方式危险因素与合并症管理。第1部分聚焦于流行病学与整合管理，将当代全球证据与亚太地区特有的数据和临床考量相结合。它为区域内临床流行病学提供了基于证据的实用建议，并介绍了整体或整合管理模式的必要性。

title: 2026 Asia Pacific Heart Rhythm Society (APHRS) Guidelines (Part IV) on Comprehensive Lifestyle Risk Factor and Comorbidity Management in Atrial Fibrillation.
summary: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is closely associated with comorbidities and lifestyle factors that influence the development, progression, and outcomes. Here the focus is on guidelines for the systematic management of hypertension, heart failure, coronary and structural heart disease, diabetes, dyslipidemia, cerebrovascular disease, obesity, chronic kidney disease, thyroid dysfunction, inflammatory disease, cancer and frailty. In addition, it provides guidelines for lifestyle factors such as nutrition, physical activity, alcohol consumption, tobacco use, sleep and psychological health as key components of AF care. Finally, multimorbidity, polypharmacy and the diverse clinical, cultural, socioeconomic and healthcare contexts of the Asia Pacific region are also addressed. Particular focus is driven by evidence to support the comprehensive management of lifestyle factors as a core component of AF care with equitable access adapted to local resources and patient needs.

AI.tldr: 2026 APHRS 指南第四部分系统提出房颤患者生活方式危险因素与合并症的综合管理路径，强调将生活方式干预作为房颤照护核心并兼顾亚太地区资源差异。
AI.motivation: 房颤的发生、进展与结局受合并症和生活方式因素显著影响，但既往指南多聚焦节律控制与抗凝，对高血压、心衰、糖尿病、肥胖、睡眠与心理等可干预因素缺乏系统整合，且亚太地区临床、文化与社会经济背景差异大，亟需区域化综合管理建议。
AI.method: 本文为 2026 年亚太心律学会（APHRS）指南第四部分，属专家共识性指南文件，非原始研究，摘要未报告研究类型、样本量、干预措施、终点定义及统计方法；内容覆盖高血压、心衰、冠脉与结构性心脏病、糖尿病、血脂异常、脑血管病、肥胖、慢性肾病、甲状腺功能异常、炎症性疾病、肿瘤及衰弱等合并症，以及营养、体力活动、饮酒、吸烟、睡眠与心理健康等生活方式因素，并讨论多重共病、多重用药及亚太地区资源可及性。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体研究数据、效应量、95% 置信区间或 P 值；指南基于现有证据提出将生活方式因素综合管理作为房颤照护核心组成部分，并主张按当地资源和患者需求实现公平可及的管理。
AI.conclusion: 该指南为亚太地区房颤患者合并症与生活方式危险因素的系统管理提供了框架，提示电生理实践中应将体重、睡眠、饮酒、运动及多重用药等纳入常规评估与随访；但作为共识性文件，其推荐强度与证据等级、具体量化目标及对硬终点的影响摘要未报告，需结合原文证据表解读。

summary_zh: 心房颤动（AF）与影响其发生、进展和结局的合并症及生活方式因素密切相关。本文重点介绍高血压、心力衰竭、冠状动脉及结构性心脏病、糖尿病、血脂异常、脑血管疾病、肥胖、慢性肾脏病、甲状腺功能障碍、炎症性疾病、癌症和衰弱的系统化管理指南。此外，还提供了关于营养、体力活动、饮酒、吸烟、睡眠和心理健康等生活方式因素的指南，这些是AF照护的关键组成部分。最后，还讨论了亚太地区的多重疾病、多重用药以及多样的临床、文化、社会经济和医疗保健背景。特别关注的是，有证据支持将生活方式因素的全面管理作为AF照护的核心组成部分，并根据当地资源和患者需求实现公平可及。

title: 2026 Asia Pacific Heart Rhythm Society (APHRS) Guidelines (Part III) on Rate and Rhythm Control in Atrial Fibrillation.
Quantifying the Functional Effect of Transmural Interpolation Strategies on Atrial Wave Propagation Using a Custom Open-Source Pipeline.
summary: Atrial fibrillation (AF) management increasingly relies on patient-specific computational modeling to simulate arrhythmia mechanisms and optimize ablation strategies. However, predictive reliability is strongly influenced by accurate reconstruction of myocardial fiber architecture, which governs electrical anisotropy. Because patient-specific atrial fiber orientations cannot currently be acquired reliably in vivo using diffusion tensor magnetic resonance imaging (DT-MRI), alternative computational mapping strategies are required. This protocol presents a comprehensive, open-source pipeline for constructing patient-specific 3D models of the human left atrium with explicit transmural fiber reconstruction from high-resolution clinical computed tomography (CT) data. The methodology extends the Universal Atrial Coordinate (UAC) framework into the volumetric domain by solving the Laplace-Dirichlet problem to derive a continuous transmural coordinate. This enables transfer of atlas-based fiber orientations and subsequent interpolation across the atrial wall. Linear and threshold-based transmural interpolation strategies are quantitatively compared, and their effects on fiber orientation and macroscopic wavefront propagation are evaluated. Across all six models, the mean angular deviation between interpolation methods was 8.06 ± 1.13°. Electrophysiological simulations demonstrate that the choice of interpolation delayed activation in Region 1 by 2.0 ± 0.6 ms, corresponding to 6.1 ± 1.5 ms (p = 0.031 for both comparisons). The open-source pipeline and patient-specific CT-based atrial models provide a reproducible framework for evaluating the functional effects of transmural fiber reconstruction strategies.

AI.tldr: 在6例基于CT的左房模型中，跨壁纤维插值策略使纤维方向平均偏差8.06°，并延迟区域1激动2.0 ms（对应6.1 ms，P=0.031），提示插值选择对房颤计算模型有功能影响。
AI.motivation: 房颤管理日益依赖患者特异性计算模型来模拟心律失常机制和优化消融策略，但预测可靠性受心肌纤维结构重建精度影响，因为纤维方向决定电各向异性。目前无法在体内可靠获取患者心房纤维方向（DT-MRI不可行），需要替代的计算映射策略，而不同跨壁插值策略对波传播的功能影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 本研究为方法学协议开发与定量比较研究，基于开源流程从高分辨率临床CT数据构建6例患者特异性左房三维模型。将Universal Atrial Coordinate（UAC）框架扩展至容积域，通过求解Laplace-Dirichlet问题获得连续跨壁坐标，实现图谱纤维方向的传递与跨壁插值。定量比较线性插值与基于阈值的跨壁插值策略，评估其对纤维方向和宏观波前传播的影响，并进行了电生理仿真。
AI.result: 全部6个模型中，两种插值方法间纤维方向平均角度偏差为8.06 ± 1.13°。电生理仿真显示，插值策略选择使区域1的激动延迟2.0 ± 0.6 ms，对应6.1 ± 1.5 ms（两项比较P值均为0.031）。摘要未报告其他终点或统计结果。
AI.conclusion: 跨壁纤维插值策略的选择会显著影响左房模型中的纤维方向和波前激动时序，提示患者特异性房颤计算模型需谨慎选择插值方法。该开源流程提供了可重复的框架来评估跨壁纤维重建的功能效应，但样本量小（6例）且缺乏体内纤维验证，临床转化需进一步研究。

summary_zh:
背景：心房颤动（AF）的管理日益依赖患者特异性计算建模来模拟心律失常机制并优化消融策略。然而，预测可靠性在很大程度上受心肌纤维结构准确重建的影响，因为心肌纤维结构决定了电各向异性。由于目前无法使用弥散张量磁共振成像（DT-MRI）在体内可靠地获取患者特异性心房纤维取向，因此需要替代的计算映射策略。

方法：本协议提出了一个全面的开源流程，用于从高分辨率临床计算机断层扫描（CT）数据构建具有明确透壁纤维重建的人类左心房患者特异性3D模型。该方法通过求解Laplace-Dirichlet问题推导连续透壁坐标，将通用心房坐标（UAC）框架扩展到体积域。这使得基于图谱的纤维取向能够转移并随后在心房壁内插值。定量比较了线性和基于阈值的透壁插值策略，并评估了它们对纤维取向和宏观波前传播的影响。

结果：在所有六个模型中，插值方法之间的平均角度偏差为8.06 ± 1.13°。电生理模拟表明，插值选择使区域1的激活延迟了2.0 ± 0.6 ms，对应于6.1 ± 1.5 ms（两项比较的p = 0.031）。

结论：开源流程和基于患者特异性CT的心房模型为评估透壁纤维重建策略的功能效应提供了可重复的框架。

title: Prospective evaluation of stereotactic arrhythmia radioablation for refractory ventricular tachycardia: initial clinical experience in Japan.
summary:
PURPOSE: This prospective study evaluated the 1 year safety and efficacy of stereotactic arrhythmia radioablation (STAR) delivered using the CyberKnife system for refractory ventricular tachycardia (VT) in Japanese patients, in accordance with a prespecified clinical protocol.

MATERIALS AND METHODS: Three male patients with radiofrequency catheter ablation (RFCA)-refractory VT and structural heart disease, namely hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM), dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM), and ischemic cardiomyopathy (ICM), were enrolled. A single fraction of 25 Gy was delivered to the target volume defined by multimodal image fusion. The primary endpoint was the absence of Grade ≥ 3 treatment-related adverse events within 12 months.

RESULTS: The primary endpoint was achieved, with no acute or subacute Grade ≥ 3 toxicities observed in any patient during the first year. Although all patients experienced a reduction in VT burden, the clinical course differed by etiology. Cases 2 (DCM) and 3 (ICM) showed typical responses, including delayed efficacy and late recurrence requiring repeat RFCA. In contrast, Case 1 (HCM), with a substantially larger target volume (133 mL), showed a rapid response but a progressive decline in left ventricular ejection fraction by myocardial scintigraphy, from 59.7% to 40.0%, during the 24 month extended follow-up.

CONCLUSION: STAR demonstrated preliminary feasibility as a noninvasive salvage therapy for refractory VT in this initial Japanese pilot experience. However, the late functional decline observed in Case 1 highlights the need for long-term follow-up and myocardium-sparing techniques for large target volumes. (jRCTs042230030).

AI.tldr: 在日本难治性室速患者中，立体定向心律失常放射消融（STAR）12个月内未出现≥3级治疗相关不良事件，但大靶体积患者随访24个月出现左室射血分数进行性下降。
AI.motivation: 难治性室性心动过速（VT）患者经射频导管消融（RFCA）失败后治疗选择有限，立体定向心律失常放射消融（STAR）作为无创挽救治疗在日本尚缺乏前瞻性临床证据，需评估其安全性和疗效。
AI.method: 前瞻性单臂研究，纳入3例RFCA难治性VT合并结构性心脏病（肥厚型心肌病、扩张型心肌病、缺血性心肌病各1例）的日本男性患者，采用CyberKnife系统单次25 Gy照射，靶区由多模态图像融合定义。主要终点为12个月内无≥3级治疗相关不良事件，并延长随访至24个月观察疗效和安全性。
AI.result: 主要终点达成，第一年无急性或亚急性≥3级毒性反应。所有患者VT负荷均下降，但病程因病因不同而异：扩张型心肌病和缺血性心肌病病例表现为延迟起效和晚期复发需重复RFCA；肥厚型心肌病病例靶体积显著较大（133 mL），起效迅速但24个月延长随访中左室射血分数从59.7%进行性下降至40.0%（心肌闪烁显像）。
AI.conclusion: STAR在日本难治性VT患者中初步显示作为无创挽救治疗的可行性，但大靶体积患者出现的晚期心功能下降提示需长期随访并采用心肌保护技术。样本量小（3例）且为单臂设计，结论需更大规模研究验证。

summary_zh:
目的：本前瞻性研究按照预先设定的临床方案，评估了使用CyberKnife系统进行立体定向心律失常放射消融（STAR）治疗日本患者难治性室性心动过速（VT）的1年安全性和有效性。

材料与方法：纳入3例男性患者，均为射频导管消融（RFCA）难治性VT合并结构性心脏病，分别为肥厚型心肌病（HCM）、扩张型心肌病（DCM）和缺血性心肌病（ICM）。通过多模态图像融合确定靶区，给予单次25 Gy照射。主要终点为12个月内无≥3级治疗相关不良事件。

结果：主要终点达成，第一年内任何患者均未观察到急性或亚急性≥3级毒性。尽管所有患者的VT负荷均减少，但临床病程因病因不同而异。病例2（DCM）和病例3（ICM）表现出典型反应，包括延迟起效和需要重复RFCA的晚期复发。相比之下，病例1（HCM）的靶区体积显著较大（133 mL），表现出快速反应，但在24个月延长随访期间，通过心肌闪烁显像观察到左心室射血分数进行性下降，从59.7%降至40.0%。

结论：在这一初步日本试点经验中，STAR作为难治性VT的无创挽救治疗显示出初步可行性。然而，病例1观察到的晚期功能下降凸显了对大靶区体积进行长期随访和心肌保护技术的必要性。（jRCTs042230030）。

title: Mindfulness-based perioperative care, sleep architecture, autonomic regulation, and early atrial tachyarrhythmia recurrence after radiofrequency catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation: a prospective observational cohort study.
summary: This study aimed to examine the relationship between perioperative care by mindfulness and sleep quality, autonomic regulation, inflammatory activity, and early recurrence of atrial tachyarrhythmia (AT) following radiofrequency catheter ablation (RFCA) for atrial fibrillation (AF). This was a prospective assessor-blinded observational cohort study involving 124 patients with AF who underwent their initial radiofrequency catheter ablation from April 2023 to December 2025. Conventional perioperative care was provided to one group (n=62), while the other group (n=62) received mindfulness-based perioperative care. To reduce baseline imbalance, propensity score overlap weighting was implemented. Objective sleep architecture was assessed by overnight polysomnography and autonomic function was examined by HRV analysis. hs-CRP, IL-6, TNF-α, IL-1β, and MCP-1 were analyzed by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assays. Health related quality of life was determined based on the SF-36 questionnaire. Compared with conventional care, mindfulness-based perioperative care was associated with greater observed changes in total sleep time (389.4 ± 43.8 vs. 365.7 ± 45.2 min, P=0.012), sleep efficiency (77.4 ± 7.2% vs. 71.2 ± 7.8%, P=0.004), sleep onset latency (27.1 ± 8.8 vs. 34.8 ± 10.5 min, P=0.009), and PSQI scores (7.2 ± 2.5 vs. 9.3 ± 2.9, P=0.006). The mindfulness group also showed lower inflammatory biomarker levels and differences in short-term autonomic indices, including a lower LF/HF ratio (1.39 ± 0.41 vs. 1.66 ± 0.54, P=0.005). Early atrial tachyarrhythmia recurrence occurred in 6 patients (9.7%) in the mindfulness-based perioperative care group and in 11 patients (17.7%) in the conventional care group, corresponding to a crude risk ratio of 0.55 (95% CI: 0.22-1.38). Mindfulness-based perioperative care was associated with improved objective and subjective sleep quality, more favorable autonomic and inflammatory biomarker profiles, better postoperative quality of life, and a lower observed rate of early atrial tachyarrhythmia recurrence after radiofrequency catheter ablation for AF.

AI.tldr: 围术期正念护理与房颤射频消融术后早期房性快速性心律失常复发率较低相关（9.7% vs 17.7%），但差异未达统计学显著（RR 0.55，95%CI 0.22-1.38）。
AI.motivation: 房颤射频消融术后早期房性快速性心律失常复发常见，睡眠障碍、自主神经功能紊乱和炎症可能参与其中。既往缺乏围术期正念干预对客观睡眠结构、自主神经调节及早期复发影响的前瞻性证据。
AI.method: 前瞻性评估者盲法观察性队列研究，纳入2023年4月至2025年12月首次接受射频消融的房颤患者124例，常规围术期护理组62例、正念围术期护理组62例，采用倾向性评分重叠加权平衡基线。通过整夜多导睡眠监测评估睡眠结构，心率变异性分析评估自主神经功能，ELISA检测hs-CRP、IL-6、TNF-α、IL-1β、MCP-1，SF-36评估生活质量。主要观察早期房性快速性心律失常复发，并比较睡眠、自主神经及炎症指标。
AI.conclusion: 围术期正念护理与房颤射频消融术后客观及主观睡眠质量改善、自主神经和炎症指标更有利、术后生活质量更好相关，并观察到早期房性快速性心律失常复发率较低，但复发差异置信区间宽且未达统计学显著。该研究为观察性设计，样本量有限，尚不能确立因果关系，需随机对照试验验证正念干预对消融术后早期复发的临床获益。

summary_zh: 本研究旨在探讨基于正念的围手术期护理与睡眠质量、自主神经调节、炎症活动及心房颤动（AF）射频导管消融（RFCA）术后早期房性快速性心律失常（AT）复发之间的关系。这是一项前瞻性评估者盲法观察性队列研究，纳入124例于2023年4月至2025年12月期间首次接受射频导管消融的AF患者。一组（n=62）接受常规围手术期护理，另一组（n=62）接受基于正念的围手术期护理。为减少基线不平衡，采用了倾向评分重叠加权。通过整夜多导睡眠监测评估客观睡眠结构，通过HRV分析检查自主神经功能。采用酶联免疫吸附试验分析hs-CRP、IL-6、TNF-α、IL-1β和MCP-1。基于SF-36问卷确定健康相关生活质量。与常规护理相比，基于正念的围手术期护理与总睡眠时间（389.4 ± 43.8 vs. 365.7 ± 45.2 min，P=0.012）、睡眠效率（77.4 ± 7.2% vs. 71.2 ± 7.8%，P=0.004）、入睡潜伏期（27.1 ± 8.8 vs. 34.8 ± 10.5 min，P=0.009）和PSQI评分（7.2 ± 2.5 vs. 9.3 ± 2.9，P=0.006）的更大观察变化相关。正念组还显示出较低的炎症生物标志物水平和短期自主神经指标的差异，包括较低的LF/HF比值（1.39 ± 0.41 vs. 1.66 ± 0.54，P=0.005）。基于正念的围手术期护理组有6例患者（9.7%）发生早期房性快速性心律失常复发，常规护理组有11例患者（17.7%），对应的粗风险比为0.55（95% CI：0.22-1.38）。基于正念的围手术期护理与改善的客观和主观睡眠质量、更有利的自主神经和炎症生物标志物特征、更好的术后生活质量以及AF射频导管消融术后早期房性快速性心律失常复发的较低观察发生率相关。

title: [Clinical characteristics and prognosis of patients with atrial functional mitral regurgitation]
summary: Compared with VFMR, AFMR is more common among elderly patients, female patients, and patients with atrial fibrillation and is less frequently accompanied by heart failure symptoms. The rates of all-cause mortality and cardiovascular death or hospitalization for heart failure are both lower in the AFMR group than those in the VFMR group.

AI.tldr: 与室性功能性二尖瓣反流相比，房性功能性二尖瓣反流多见于高龄、女性及房颤患者，心衰症状较少，全因死亡与心血管死亡或心衰住院率均更低。
AI.motivation: 功能性二尖瓣反流既往多按室性病因（左室重构、缺血）分类与管理，房性功能性二尖瓣反流（AFMR，继发于房颤伴心房扩大、瓣环扩张而左室结构与功能相对保留）的临床特征与预后证据不足，其与室性功能性二尖瓣反流（VFMR）的差异尚不明确，影响风险分层与随访策略。
AI.method: 研究类型与样本量：摘要未报告。研究对象为功能性二尖瓣反流患者，按病因分为 AFMR 组与 VFMR 组。暴露/分组因素为二尖瓣反流的功能性病因（房性 vs 室性）。终点包括全因死亡、心血管死亡或心衰住院。统计方法：摘要未报告。
AI.result: AFMR 组患者年龄更大、女性比例更高、合并房颤者更多，伴心衰症状者较少。AFMR 组全因死亡率及心血管死亡或心衰住院率均低于 VFMR 组。具体效应量、95%CI 与 P 值摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: AFMR 是一类具有独特人群特征且预后相对较好的功能性二尖瓣反流亚型，提示临床应对 AFMR 与 VFMR 区别评估与管理，房颤节律控制及心房重构可能为其重要干预方向。局限性：摘要未报告样本量、随访时间、统计方法与效应量，结论的稳健性有待全文数据验证。

summary_zh: 与VFMR相比，AFMR在老年患者、女性患者以及心房颤动患者中更为常见，且较少伴有心力衰竭症状。AFMR组的全因死亡率和心血管死亡或因心力衰竭住院的发生率均低于VFMR组。

title: A Case Report of Lyme Carditis Presenting as New-Onset Atrial Flutter in the Emergency Department.
summary: Lyme disease (LD) is the most common vector-borne disease in the United States and has several well-known pathologic sequelae if not treated, including third-degree atrioventricular block. However, an association between Lyme carditis and atrial arrhythmias has been described in some cardiology literature but has not been reported in emergency medicine or wilderness medicine literature. This case report describes an older adult with new-onset atrial flutter with rapid ventricular rate in the setting of early disseminated LD, who ultimately was treated with antibiotics, had resolution of atrial flutter, and has had no recurrence. As cardiac inflammation secondary to organ infection may manifest as multiple forms of arrhythmia, this case report highlights the importance of considering LD as a differential diagnosis when treating tick-exposed patients with new cardiac arrhythmias, including atrial flutter.

AI.tldr: 一例早期播散性莱姆病老年患者以新发心房扑动伴快速心室率就诊，抗生素治疗后房扑消失且未复发。
AI.motivation: 莱姆病是美国最常见的虫媒传染病，已知可致三度房室传导阻滞等后遗症；莱姆心脏炎与房性心律失常的关联仅见于部分心脏病学文献，急诊医学与野外医学文献尚未报告，临床对蜱暴露患者新发房性心律失常时易漏诊莱姆病。
AI.method: 病例报告（单例）。对象为一名有蜱暴露史的老年患者，在急诊科因新发心房扑动伴快速心室率就诊，处于早期播散性莱姆病阶段；干预为抗生素治疗；观察终点为房扑是否转复及随访期是否复发。摘要未报告具体年龄、性别、心电图参数、抗生素方案及随访时长，亦未涉及统计方法。
AI.result: 抗生素治疗后心房扑动转复，随访期内未见复发。摘要未报告心室率、房扑周长、转复时间、随访时长及任何效应量或P值。
AI.conclusion: 提示对蜱暴露且出现新发心律失常（包括心房扑动）的患者，应将莱姆病纳入鉴别诊断，因感染继发的心脏炎症可表现为多种心律失常。该结论来自单例病例报告，证据级别低，不能据此推断因果关系或发生率，需更大样本观察验证。

summary_zh: 莱姆病（LD）是美国最常见的媒介传播疾病，若不治疗，有若干众所周知的病理后遗症，包括三度房室传导阻滞。然而，莱姆心脏炎与房性心律失常之间的关联已在一些心脏病学文献中有所描述，但尚未在急诊医学或荒野医学文献中报道。本病例报告描述了一位患有早期播散性LD的老年人，表现为新发心房扑动伴快速心室率，最终接受抗生素治疗，心房扑动消退，且未再复发。由于器官感染继发的心脏炎症可能表现为多种形式的心律失常，本病例报告强调了在治疗有蜱暴露史且出现新发心律失常（包括心房扑动）的患者时，考虑将LD作为鉴别诊断的重要性。

title: The evolution and future of conduction system pacing.
summary: Cardiac pacing has undergone a fundamental paradigm shift from conventional right ventricular apical pacing towards physiological activation of the native conduction system of the heart. Decades of evidence have established that chronic right ventricular pacing induces ventricular dyssynchrony, contributing to pacing-induced cardiomyopathy and adverse clinical outcomes. Conduction system pacing, which engages the intrinsic His-Purkinje network of the heart, has emerged as a transformative approach that preserves or restores the natural ventricular activation sequence. His bundle pacing, the earliest form of conduction system pacing, provided proof of concept but is limited by technical challenges and high capture thresholds. Left bundle branch area pacing has since become the dominant modality, offering greater procedural success, lead stability and broader applicability: from management of bradycardia and prevention of pacing-induced cardiomyopathy to cardiac resynchronization therapy in heart failure. Bachmann bundle area pacing is an emerging atrial counterpart: by capturing a preferential interatrial conduction pathway, this approach reduces interatrial conduction delay and produces a more physiological atrial activation sequence than conventional right atrial appendage pacing. Bachmann bundle area pacing might, therefore, help to prevent atrial fibrillation. In this Review, we bring these ventricular and atrial strategies together under the unifying principle of physiological pacing, describe their mechanistic basis and technical evolution, appraise the latest evidence from randomized trials and address the practical questions that arise in clinical application, indicating where more evidence is required.

AI.tldr: 本综述系统梳理了传导系统起搏从希氏束起搏向左束支区域起搏的演变，并介绍Bachmann束区域起搏作为心房生理性起搏的新方向，指出其可能有助于预防房颤。
AI.motivation: 传统右室心尖部起搏会导致心室不同步，进而引起起搏诱导性心肌病和不良临床结局；传导系统起搏通过激动自身希氏-浦肯野系统来保留或恢复生理性心室激动顺序，但不同术式（希氏束起搏、左束支区域起搏、Bachmann束区域起搏）的机制、技术演进与随机试验证据尚需系统整合，临床应用中的实际问题也缺乏统一梳理。
AI.method: 本文为Nat Rev Cardiol发表的综述，非原始研究，无样本量与干预分组。文章将心室与心房的生理性起搏策略统一归纳，阐述其机制基础与技术演变，评价最新随机试验证据，并讨论临床应用中的实际问题及仍需更多证据的方向；摘要未报告具体终点定义与统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果。综述指出：希氏束起搏是最早的传导系统起搏形式，提供了概念验证，但受技术难度大和捕获阈值高的限制；左束支区域起搏已成为主流术式，具有更高的手术成功率、导线稳定性和更广的适用性，涵盖心动过缓治疗、起搏诱导性心肌病预防以及心力衰竭的心脏再同步治疗；Bachmann束区域起搏是新兴的心房对应策略，通过夺获优先的房内传导通路减少房内传导延迟，较常规右心耳起搏产生更生理的心房激动顺序，可能有助于预防房颤。
AI.conclusion: 传导系统起搏代表了从右室心尖部起搏向生理性起搏的范式转变，左束支区域起搏已成为心室层面主流选择，Bachmann束区域起搏则有望成为心房层面的生理性起搏并预防房颤。综述强调仍需更多随机试验证据来明确适应证、长期获益及临床实践中的技术问题；本文为叙述性综述，未提供新的原始数据，结论受现有证据水平限制。

summary_zh: 心脏起搏已从传统的右心室心尖部起搏向心脏自身传导系统的生理性激活发生了根本性的范式转变。数十年的证据已证实，长期右心室起搏可诱发心室不同步，导致起搏诱导性心肌病和不良临床结局。传导系统起搏通过夺获心脏固有的希氏-浦肯野网络，已成为一种变革性方法，能够保留或恢复自然的室性激动顺序。希氏束起搏作为传导系统起搏的最早形式，提供了概念验证，但受限于技术挑战和高夺获阈值。左束支区域起搏此后已成为主导模式，具有更高的手术成功率、导线稳定性和更广泛的适用性：从心动过缓的管理和起搏诱导性心肌病的预防，到心力衰竭中的心脏再同步治疗。巴赫曼束区域起搏是一种新兴的心房对应策略：通过夺获优先的房内传导通路，该方法减少房内传导延迟，并产生比传统右心耳起搏更符合生理的心房激动顺序。因此，巴赫曼束区域起搏可能有助于预防心房颤动。在本综述中，我们将这些心室和心房策略统一在生理性起搏的原则之下，描述其机制基础和技术演变，评估随机试验的最新证据，并探讨临床应用中出现实际问题，指出需要更多证据的领域。

title: Continuous Stellate Ganglion Block Bridging to Cardiac Sympathetic Denervation in a Long QT Syndrome Neonate.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Congenital long QT syndrome (LQTS) with neonatal onset carries a high risk of drug-refractory ventricular arrhythmias. Continuous percutaneous left stellate ganglion block (PLSGB) as a bridge to left cardiac sympathetic denervation (LCSD) is unexplored in neonates.

CASE SUMMARY: We present a newborn female with in utero onset LQTS, complicated by functional 2:1 atrioventricular block and torsades de pointes (TdP). Despite pacemaker implantation, propranolol, and mexiletine, TdP recurred. At 25 days of life, continuous PLSGB with ropivacaine suppressed TdP. At 4 months, video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (VATS)-LCSD was performed, with no ventricular arrhythmia recurrence in 24 months.

NOVELTY: First reported case of continuous PLSGB in a neonate with LQTS; among the few VATS-LCSD cases under 1 year.

TAKE-HOME MESSAGES: Early sympathetic neuromodulation should be considered in high-risk pediatric LQTS when medical therapy fails, as a bridge to LCSD. VATS-LCSD is feasible and safe even under 1 year.

AI.tldr: 新生儿先天性长QT综合征经药物和起搏器治疗仍反复发生尖端扭转型室速，连续经皮左侧星状神经节阻滞可有效抑制心律失常，作为桥接至电视辅助胸腔镜左心交感神经去神经术，术后24个月无复发。
AI.motivation: 新生儿期发病的先天性长QT综合征患者发生药物难治性室性心律失常的风险高，而连续经皮左侧星状神经节阻滞作为桥接至左心交感神经去神经术的策略在新生儿中尚未被探索。
AI.method: 病例报告：一名女性新生儿，宫内起病的长QT综合征，合并功能性2:1房室传导阻滞和尖端扭转型室速。尽管植入起搏器并给予普萘洛尔和墨西哥林治疗，尖端扭转型室速仍复发。出生后25天开始使用罗哌卡因进行连续经皮左侧星状神经节阻滞，4个月时行电视辅助胸腔镜左心交感神经去神经术。主要观察指标为室性心律失常复发情况。
AI.result: 连续经皮左侧星状神经节阻滞后尖端扭转型室速被抑制；4个月时行电视辅助胸腔镜左心交感神经去神经术，术后24个月无室性心律失常复发。
AI.conclusion: 对于高风险儿科长QT综合征患者，当药物治疗失败时，应尽早考虑交感神经调控，作为桥接至左心交感神经去神经术的策略；电视辅助胸腔镜左心交感神经去神经术在1岁以下婴儿中可行且安全。本报告为首次在新生儿中应用连续经皮左侧星状神经节阻滞，但为单例病例报告，结论需进一步研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：新生儿期发病的先天性长QT综合征（LQTS）具有药物难治性室性心律失常的高风险。连续经皮左侧星状神经节阻滞（PLSGB）作为左侧心脏交感神经去支配术（LCSD）的桥接治疗在新生儿中尚未被探索。

病例摘要：我们报告一名女性新生儿，宫内发病的LQTS，并发功能性2:1房室传导阻滞和尖端扭转型室速（TdP）。尽管植入了起搏器，并使用了普萘洛尔和美西律，TdP仍复发。在出生后25天，使用罗哌卡因的连续PLSGB抑制了TdP。在4个月时，进行了电视辅助胸腔镜手术（VATS）-LCSD，24个月内无室性心律失常复发。

新颖性：首例报道在LQTS新生儿中使用连续PLSGB；是1岁以下少数VATS-LCSD病例之一。

要点：对于药物治疗失败的高危儿科LQTS，应考虑早期交感神经调节作为LCSD的桥接。VATS-LCSD即使在1岁以下也是可行和安全的。

title: Transient ST-T Changes During Submaximal Exercise Revealing Anomalous Right Coronary Artery Origin in an Asymptomatic Athlete.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Anomalous aortic origin of a coronary artery is a recognised structural cause of sudden cardiac death in athletes younger than 35 years. Most affected individuals are asymptomatic prior to cardiac events, and resting and exercise electrocardiography (ECG) findings are frequently normal or non-specific, limiting the effectiveness of preparticipation screening.

CASE SUMMARY: We report a case of a 22-year-old asymptomatic athlete in whom preparticipation screening revealed transient ST-segment depression and T-wave inversions during submaximal exercise and recovery, whereas findings at peak exercise remained normal. Point-of-care echocardiography performed by a sports medicine specialist raised suspicion of an anomalous origin of the right coronary artery from the left aortic sinus of Valsalva, which was subsequently confirmed by computed tomography coronary angiography. High-risk anatomical features included an acute ostial angle and an interarterial course of the right coronary artery. Functional testing with exercise myocardial stress scintigraphy showed no inducible perfusion defect. Following multidisciplinary consultation, a conservative management strategy with activity modification and close follow-up was adopted.

DISCUSSION: This case highlights the potential clinical significance of transient ST-T abnormalities occurring during submaximal exercise and recovery, even in the absence of symptoms or abnormalities at peak workload. In this patient, recognition of this reproducible but non-specific ECG pattern prompted further structural evaluation leading to the diagnosis of AAOCA. It also underscores the limitations of current guidelines in managing asymptomatic athletes with high-risk coronary anatomy but without evidence of inducible ischaemia, supporting the need for individualised decision-making.

AI.tldr: 一例22岁无症状运动员在次极量运动及恢复期出现一过性ST-T改变，而峰值运动正常，由此发现右冠状动脉异常起源于左冠窦，提示次极量运动心电图在赛前筛查中的潜在价值。
AI.motivation: 冠状动脉异常起源于主动脉是35岁以下运动员心源性猝死的已知结构原因，但多数患者在心脏事件前无症状，静息和运动心电图常正常或非特异，限制了赛前筛查的有效性。
AI.method: 病例报告。对象为22岁无症状运动员，赛前筛查行运动心电图，发现次极量运动及恢复期一过性ST段压低和T波倒置，峰值运动正常。运动医学专家行床旁超声心动图怀疑右冠状动脉异常起源，经CT冠状动脉造影确诊，并评估解剖高危特征。行运动心肌灌注显像评估功能缺血。
AI.result: CT冠状动脉造影证实右冠状动脉异常起源于左主动脉窦，高危解剖特征包括开口锐角和动脉间走行。运动心肌灌注显像未显示可诱发的灌注缺损。经多学科会诊后采取保守管理策略，包括调整运动方式和密切随访。
AI.conclusion: 本病例提示次极量运动及恢复期一过性ST-T异常即使无症状且峰值运动正常也可能具有临床意义，可促使进一步结构评估以诊断冠状动脉异常起源。同时凸显当前指南对无症状但高危冠状动脉解剖且无诱发性缺血运动员管理的局限性，支持个体化决策。

summary_zh:
背景：冠状动脉主动脉起源异常是公认的导致35岁以下运动员心源性猝死的结构性原因。大多数受累个体在心脏事件发生前无症状，静息和运动心电图（ECG）检查结果常为正常或非特异性，限制了赛前筛查的有效性。

病例摘要：我们报告一例22岁无症状运动员，赛前筛查显示在次极量运动和恢复期间出现一过性ST段压低和T波倒置，而峰值运动时检查结果正常。由运动医学专家进行的床旁超声心动图检查提示右冠状动脉起源于左主动脉窦（Valsalva窦）异常，随后经计算机断层扫描冠状动脉造影证实。高风险解剖特征包括锐利的开口角度和右冠状动脉的动脉间走行。运动心肌负荷闪烁显像的功能测试显示无诱发性灌注缺损。经过多学科会诊，采取了保守管理策略，包括调整活动和密切随访。

讨论：本病例强调了在次极量运动和恢复期间出现的一过性ST-T异常，即使在没有症状或峰值负荷时无异常的情况下，也可能具有潜在的临床意义。在该患者中，识别出这种可重复但非特异性的ECG模式促使进一步的结构评估，从而诊断为AAOCA。这也凸显了当前指南在管理无症状运动员中的局限性，这些运动员具有高风险冠状动脉解剖但无诱发性缺血的证据，支持个体化决策的必要性。

title: Bidirectional ventricular tachycardia unmasked by beta-blockade in pheochromocytoma presenting as hypertensive optic neuropathy: a case report and literature review.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Pheochromocytoma is a catecholamine-secreting neuroendocrine tumor that can produce life-threatening cardiovascular complications. Bidirectional ventricular tachycardia (BVT) is a rare arrhythmia with a narrow differential diagnosis, classically associated with digitalis toxicity and catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia, and only exceptionally reported as the presenting feature of pheochromocytoma.

CASE PRESENTATION: A 51-year-old woman presented with acute visual impairment secondary to hypertensive optic neuropathy; her blood pressure was 220/138 mmHg. Within 24 h of initiating sodium nitroprusside and metoprolol, she developed bidirectional ventricular tachycardia followed by torsades de pointes. Marked blood-pressure lability, dramatically elevated plasma free metanephrines and catecholamines, and a left adrenal mass on computed tomography established the diagnosis of pheochromocytoma. After alpha-adrenergic blockade with phenoxybenzamine, laparoscopic adrenalectomy was performed, and histopathology confirmed the diagnosis. No ventricular arrhythmia recurred, and blood pressure normalized without antihypertensive medication.

CONCLUSION: Bidirectional ventricular tachycardia may be the initial manifestation of pheochromocytoma and may be unmasked by beta-blockade administered before alpha-blockade. Unexplained BVT accompanied by blood-pressure fluctuations should prompt biochemical screening and adrenal imaging. Etiologic treatment is curative, whereas antiarrhythmic therapy alone is insufficient. We review the previously published cases to contextualize this rare phenotype.

AI.tldr: 51岁女性嗜铬细胞瘤患者，在未先用α受体阻滞剂的情况下使用β受体阻滞剂后诱发双向性室速，经α受体阻滞及肿瘤切除后心律失常未再复发。
AI.motivation: 嗜铬细胞瘤可分泌儿茶酚胺导致致命性心血管并发症，而双向性室速（BVT）是一种罕见心律失常，经典病因包括洋地黄中毒和儿茶酚胺敏感性多形性室速，仅极少数报道作为嗜铬细胞瘤的首发表现。本研究旨在通过一例病例报告及文献复习，提高对嗜铬细胞瘤相关BVT的认识，强调β受体阻滞剂在未使用α受体阻滞剂前的潜在风险。
AI.method: 病例报告：51岁女性，因高血压性视神经病变导致急性视力损害就诊，血压220/138 mmHg。在启动硝普钠和美托洛尔治疗后24小时内出现双向性室速，随后进展为尖端扭转型室速。通过血压剧烈波动、血浆游离甲氧基肾上腺素和儿茶酚胺显著升高以及CT显示左侧肾上腺肿块确诊嗜铬细胞瘤。治疗包括酚苄明α受体阻滞后行腹腔镜肾上腺切除术，并复习既往文献。
AI.result: 患者在使用β受体阻滞剂后出现BVT及尖端扭转型室速，确诊嗜铬细胞瘤后经α受体阻滞和手术切除，未再发生室性心律失常，血压恢复正常且无需降压药物。摘要未报告具体生化数值、影像学尺寸及随访时间等定量数据。
AI.conclusion: BVT可能是嗜铬细胞瘤的首发表现，并可在未先用α受体阻滞剂的情况下被β受体阻滞剂诱发。对于不明原因BVT伴血压波动的患者，应进行生化筛查和肾上腺影像学检查。病因治疗可治愈，而单纯抗心律失常治疗不足。临床电生理实践中需警惕β受体阻滞剂在嗜铬细胞瘤中的潜在致心律失常风险。

summary_zh:
背景：嗜铬细胞瘤是一种分泌儿茶酚胺的神经内分泌肿瘤，可导致危及生命的心血管并发症。双向性室性心动过速（BVT）是一种罕见的、鉴别诊断范围窄的心律失常，经典上与洋地黄中毒和儿茶酚胺敏感性多形性室性心动过速相关，仅极少数情况下被报道为嗜铬细胞瘤的首发表现。

病例介绍：一名51岁女性因高血压性视神经病变继发急性视力损害就诊；其血压为220/138 mmHg。在开始使用硝普钠和美托洛尔后24小时内，她出现了双向性室性心动过速，随后发生尖端扭转型室速。显著的血压波动、血浆游离甲氧基肾上腺素类和儿茶酚胺类显著升高，以及计算机断层扫描显示左侧肾上腺肿块，确立了嗜铬细胞瘤的诊断。在使用酚苄明进行α-肾上腺素能阻滞后，实施了腹腔镜肾上腺切除术，组织病理学证实了诊断。未再复发室性心律失常，且在不使用降压药物的情况下血压恢复正常。

结论：双向性室性心动过速可能是嗜铬细胞瘤的首发表现，并可能被在α-阻滞剂之前使用的β-阻滞剂所揭露。不明原因的BVT伴随血压波动应促使进行生化筛查和肾上腺影像学检查。病因治疗可治愈，而单纯抗心律失常治疗不足。我们回顾了先前发表的病例，以对此罕见表型进行背景分析。

title: Understanding veteran perspectives surrounding implantable cardioverter- defibrillator decision-making.
summary:
BACKGROUND: In 2018, the Center for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) mandated the use of evidence-based shared decision-making (SDM) tools for cardiovascular decisions, including implantable cardioverter defibrillator (ICD) implantation for primary prevention in patients with systolic heart failure. Military Veterans are a unique population with experiences including combat, and heightened rates of anxiety, depression and post-traumatic stress disorder. Understanding Veteran perspectives on ICD decision-making processes is necessary to inform the Veteran Health Administration's (VHA) ICD care model.

STUDY OBJECTIVE: To understand factors influencing Veterans' ICD decision-making, semi-structured interviews were conducted with Veteran patients with an ICD (Implanters), those referred for consideration (Deliberators), and those who declined (Decliners).

METHODS: Interviews explored experiences with being offered an ICD, understanding of the device, and factors influencing personal decisions. Data were analyzed using content and thematic analysis.

RESULTS: Interviews with 13 participants revealed four primary themes that guided ICD decision-making: (1) desire for information and involvement in personal decisions, (2) quality of life values, (3) views of spirituality (4) Decliners and Deliberators accepted natural death and expressed desire to not intervene medically to prolong life.Participants valued consultation with providers and personal networks, yet ultimately prioritized autonomy. The role of mental health experiences and cohort-level differences on decision-making was inconclusive.

CONCLUSION: Participants' ICD implantation decision-making were influenced by considerations around quality of life, spiritual beliefs, and reluctance to invasively interfere with disease progression. These insights highlight the importance of personalized patient-provider interactions and the need for decision-support tools tailored to VHA Veteran care.

AI.tldr: 13名退伍军人定性访谈显示，ICD决策受生活质量价值观、精神信仰及不愿侵入性干预疾病进程影响，强调个体化医患沟通与定制决策支持工具。
AI.motivation: 2018年CMS要求心血管决策（包括收缩性心衰患者一级预防ICD植入）使用基于证据的共享决策工具。退伍军人具有战斗经历及焦虑、抑郁、PTSD高发特点，需了解其对ICD决策过程的看法以指导VHA的ICD照护模式。
AI.method: 定性研究，对13名退伍军人进行半结构化访谈，包括已植入ICD者、转诊考虑者及拒绝者。访谈探讨被提供ICD的经历、对设备的理解及影响个人决策的因素，采用内容与主题分析。
AI.result: 提炼出四个指导ICD决策的主题：（1）渴望信息并参与个人决策；（2）生活质量价值观；（3）精神信仰观点；（4）拒绝者和考虑者接受自然死亡，表示不愿医疗干预延长生命。参与者重视与提供者及个人网络的咨询，但最终优先自主权。心理健康经历的作用及队列层面差异对决策的影响尚无定论。
AI.conclusion: 退伍军人ICD植入决策受生活质量、精神信仰及不愿侵入性干预疾病进展影响。提示个体化医患互动的重要性，需为VHA退伍军人照护定制决策支持工具。摘要未报告样本量以外的统计结果，结论基于定性分析。

summary_zh:
背景：2018年，美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）强制要求在心血管决策中使用基于证据的共享决策（SDM）工具，包括对收缩性心力衰竭患者为一级预防而进行的植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）植入。退伍军人是一个独特的群体，其经历包括战斗，并且焦虑、抑郁和创伤后应激障碍的发生率较高。了解退伍军人对ICD决策过程的看法对于为退伍军人健康管理局（VHA）的ICD护理模式提供信息是必要的。

研究目的：为了了解影响退伍军人ICD决策的因素，对已植入ICD的退伍军人患者（植入者）、被转诊考虑的患者（考虑者）以及拒绝的患者（拒绝者）进行了半结构化访谈。

方法：访谈探讨了被提供ICD的经历、对设备的理解以及影响个人决策的因素。数据采用内容分析和主题分析进行分析。

结果：对13名参与者的访谈揭示了指导ICD决策的四个主要主题：（1）对信息和个人决策参与的渴望，（2）生活质量价值观，（3）对灵性的看法（4）拒绝者和考虑者接受自然死亡，并表示不希望进行医疗干预以延长生命。参与者重视与提供者和个人网络的咨询，但最终优先考虑自主权。心理健康经历的作用以及队列层面的决策差异尚无定论。

结论：参与者的ICD植入决策受到关于生活质量、精神信仰以及不愿侵入性干扰疾病进展的考虑的影​​响。这些见解强调了个性化患者-提供者互动的重要性，以及需要为VHA退伍军人护理量身定制的决策支持工具。

title: Preprocedural Computed Tomography Guidance Improves Accuracy of Right Ventricular Septal Lead Placement in Pacemaker Implantation.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Accurate right ventricular septal lead placement is crucial for optimal pacemaker performance and procedural safety, yet conventional fluoroscopy-guided implantation is limited by inter-individual anatomical variability. We therefore examined whether preprocedural computed tomography (CT) can provide patient-specific anatomical guidance to enable precise lead positioning.

METHODS AND RESULTS: We retrospectively analyzed 501 consecutive patients who underwent initial dual-chamber pacemaker implantation for bradycardia pacing (non-CT-guided, n = 243; CT-guided, n = 258). In the CT-guided group, the midseptal target was determined preoperatively using multiplanar reconstruction of CT images, and reference lines were projected onto the scout image to guide lead placement. We evaluated the total procedure time, fluoroscopy time, right ventricular lead electrical parameters, implantation site, and complications. CT guidance was associated with a higher rate of septal lead placement than non-CT guidance (93.0% vs. 55.6%, p < 0.001), whereas free-wall lead placement was less frequent (7.0% vs. 44.4%, p < 0.001). The procedural radiation dose was lower with CT guidance (CT-guided, 100.2 ± 124.6 mGy vs. non-CT-guided, 169.1 ± 152.4 mGy; p < 0.001). Among patients with complete atrioventricular block and available postoperative paced QRS measurements (n = 303), QRS duration was shorter in the CT-guided group than in the non-CT-guided group (145.3 ± 22.3 ms [n = 165] vs. 155.4 ± 19.0 ms [n = 138], p < 0.001). The association persisted after multivariable adjustment ((adjusted OR, 10.30; 95% CI, 5.91-17.97; p < 0.001). The total procedure time, fluoroscopy time, and pacing parameters were comparable between the groups. Complication rates were low overall, and pocket hematoma was less frequent in the CT-guided group (0.4% vs. 2.9%, p = 0.03).

CONCLUSION: Preprocedural CT guidance facilitated precise planning of the right ventricular lead target using scout images and was associated with accurate and reproducible placement at the intended septal site without prolonging procedural time or compromising electrical performance. This approach may represent a practical strategy for optimizing lead placement in bradycardia pacing.

title: Conservative management of a dislodged leadless pacemaker wedged in the pulmonary artery assessed by pulmonary perfusion scintigraphy: a case report.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Leadless pacemakers reduce complications associated with conventional transvenous systems; however, device dislodgement with pulmonary artery embolization is a rare complication unique to leadless pacemakers. Although prompt retrieval is generally recommended, retrieval from the pulmonary artery may carry procedural risks, particularly in elderly or high-risk patients.

CASE SUMMARY: An 84-year-old woman with complete atrioventricular block underwent implantation of a leadless pacemaker. Although the pacing threshold was favourable, the R-wave amplitude was low, and unstable device movement was observed after tether release, suggesting inadequate fixation. Two hours after implantation, pacing failure occurred, and chest radiography showed migration of the device into the right pulmonary artery. The following day, the device migrated to the left posterior basal segmental pulmonary artery and remained stably wedged. Because of the risk associated with retrieval, conservative management was selected, and a transvenous pacemaker was implanted. Serial lung perfusion scintigraphy demonstrated right-to-left perfusion distributions of 60.5% vs. 39.5% at 10 days, 59.1% vs. 40.9% at 3 months, and 58.5% vs. 41.5% at 1 year, without progressive deterioration in left lung volume. The patient remained asymptomatic over 3 years of follow-up.

DISCUSSION: This case illustrates that conservative management may be feasible in carefully selected high-risk patients when an embolized leadless pacemaker is stably wedged within the pulmonary artery. Serial pulmonary perfusion scintigraphy may provide objective evidence of preserved pulmonary perfusion and support long-term follow-up after conservative management.

AI.tldr: 84岁高龄女性无导线起搏器植入后发生装置脱落并栓塞至肺动脉，因高风险选择保守治疗，系列肺灌注显像显示1年内双肺血流分布稳定，随访3年无症状。

AI.method: 病例报告。84岁女性，完全性房室传导阻滞，植入无导线起搏器。术后2小时起搏失败，胸片示装置迁移至右肺动脉，次日迁移至左后基底段肺动脉并稳定嵌顿。因取出风险高，选择保守治疗并植入经静脉起搏器。采用系列肺灌注显像评估肺血流分布，随访3年。

背景：无导线起搏器减少了与传统经静脉系统相关的并发症；然而，装置脱落伴肺动脉栓塞是无导线起搏器特有的一种罕见并发症。尽管通常建议及时取出，但从肺动脉取出可能带来手术风险，尤其是在老年或高危患者中。

病例摘要：一位84岁患有完全性房室传导阻滞的女性接受了无导线起搏器植入。尽管起搏阈值良好，但R波振幅较低，并且在释放系绳后观察到装置运动不稳定，提示固定不充分。植入后两小时发生起搏失败，胸部X线摄影显示装置迁移至右肺动脉。次日，装置迁移至左后基底段肺动脉并保持稳定楔入。由于取出相关的风险，选择了保守管理，并植入了经静脉起搏器。系列肺灌注显像显示右至左灌注分布分别为10天时的60.5% vs. 39.5%、3个月时的59.1% vs. 40.9%和1年时的58.5% vs. 41.5%，左肺体积无进行性恶化。患者在3年随访期间保持无症状。

讨论：本病例表明，当栓塞的无导线起搏器稳定楔入肺动脉内时，在精心选择的高危患者中保守管理可能是可行的。系列肺灌注显像可能提供肺灌注保留的客观证据，并支持保守管理后的长期随访。

title: Successful extravascular implantable cardioverter defibrillator implantation in a patient with ankylosing spondylitis and severe thoracic deformity: a case report.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Severe thoracic deformity in ankylosing spondylitis (AS) can complicate implantable cardioverter defibrillator (ICD) implantation and device selection. Substernal EV-ICD implantation requires careful anatomical assessment and individualized procedural planning.

CASE SUMMARY: A 57-year-old male with severe AS and dilated cardiomyopathy was referred for primary prevention ICD implantation. Given the high complication risks associated with conventional approaches, EV-ICD was selected. A tailored positioning strategy was employed to accommodate the thoracic deformity. Intraoperative resistance during substernal dissection was successfully overcome through meticulous re-dissection. Favourable intraoperative electrical parameters were obtained, including an R-wave sensing amplitude of 5.6 mV without P-wave oversensing and successful defibrillation at 30 J on the first attempt. At 6-month follow-up, device performance remained stable without sensing anomalies or inappropriate shocks.

DISCUSSION: This case demonstrates the technical feasibility of EV-ICD implantation in a carefully selected patient with severe AS-associated thoracic deformity. Preoperative CT assessment, tailored patient positioning, careful dissection, and surgical backup enabled successful implantation and stable device performance during 6 months of follow-up.

AI.tldr: 一例57岁强直性脊柱炎合并严重胸廓畸形、扩张型心肌病的患者，经术前CT评估与个体化体位及解剖策略，成功植入胸骨下EV-ICD，6个月随访参数稳定、无误放电。
AI.motivation: 强直性脊柱炎所致严重胸廓畸形会改变胸骨后间隙解剖，使传统经静脉ICD及胸骨下EV-ICD植入的路径、感知与除颤效果面临不确定性；此类患者器械选择与手术规划缺乏现成经验，需探索可行的个体化方案。
AI.method: 单例病例报告。对象为57岁男性，严重强直性脊柱炎合并扩张型心肌病，因一级预防指征转诊植入ICD；因常规路径并发症风险高而选择EV-ICD。术前CT评估胸骨后解剖，采用个体化体位与胸骨下隧道分离策略，记录术中电学参数（R波感知幅度、P波过感知、除颤阈值）并随访6个月观察器械性能、感知异常与不适当放电。
AI.result: 术中胸骨下分离遇阻力，经细致再分离后完成植入；R波感知幅度5.6 mV，无P波过感知；首次30 J除颤即成功。6个月随访器械性能稳定，无感知异常，无不适当放电。摘要未报告除颤阻抗、起搏阈值等其他参数。
AI.conclusion: 本病例提示，经严格筛选并配合术前CT评估、个体化体位、细致分离及外科后备，严重强直性脊柱炎胸廓畸形患者可成功植入EV-ICD并获得短期稳定性能。结论仅来自单例、随访6个月，长期感知与除颤可靠性及可推广性仍需更多病例验证，不能据此改变现有器械选择流程。

summary_zh:
背景：强直性脊柱炎（AS）导致的严重胸廓畸形可能使植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）的植入和设备选择复杂化。胸骨下EV-ICD植入需要仔细的解剖评估和个体化的手术规划。

病例摘要：一名57岁男性，患有严重AS和扩张型心肌病，因一级预防转诊接受ICD植入。鉴于传统方法相关的高并发症风险，选择了EV-ICD。采用量身定制的定位策略以适应胸廓畸形。通过细致的重新分离，成功克服了胸骨下分离过程中的术中阻力。获得了良好的术中电参数，包括R波感知振幅为5.6 mV，无P波过感知，并且首次尝试即以30 J成功除颤。在6个月随访时，设备性能保持稳定，无感知异常或不适当电击。

讨论：本病例证明了在精心选择的严重AS相关胸廓畸形患者中植入EV-ICD的技术可行性。术前CT评估、量身定制的患者体位、仔细的分离和手术后备支持使得成功植入并在6个月随访期间设备性能稳定。

title: Optimal depolarization sequence for cardiac resynchronization therapy patients.
summary:
AIMS: Electrical ventricular dyssynchrony is a hallmark of intraventricular conduction disease in heart failure with reduced ejection fraction. Although cardiac resynchronization therapy (CRT) is effective, a proportion of patients with electrical dyssynchrony evidenced by an electrocardiogram (ECG) remain non-responders. Besides the QRS duration, visualization and quantification of the depolarization sequence could contribute to improving CRT response. The study aimed to evaluate the CineECG-derived mean temporo-spatial isochrone trajectory of depolarization in CRT patients.

METHODS AND RESULTS: Among the adult cohort of 121 patients who underwent CRT implantation, there were 93 (33% female) responders and 28 (7% female) non-responders. ECGs recorded before and immediately after CRT implantation were collected and analysed using the CineECG modality with a generic heart/torso model. The CineECG-derived path directions were computed for the QRS on anteroposterior, interventricular, and apicobasal axes within the cardiac anatomy. Spatial depolarization characteristics were tested for the association with left ventricle reverse-remodelling at 6-month follow-up. The pre-implantation depolarization sequence was predominantly from the right to the left ventricle, and after the CRT implant, it has been transformed into an apicobasal direction. In multivariate logistic regression, the pre-implant QRS duration, apicobasal depolarization gradient, and CRT-induced QRS shortening independently predicted CRT response. The Akaike information criterion indicated that combining all three yielded the strongest predictive model.

CONCLUSION: CineECG-derived depolarization gradients, which reflect ventricular activation sequence, changed significantly after CRT, and the pre-implantation apicobasal gradient independently predicted echocardiographic outcome, with a less pronounced gradient associated with better haemodynamic response.

AI.tldr: 在121例CRT患者中，CineECG衍生的植入前心尖-基底去极化梯度可独立预测6个月左室逆重构，梯度越小反应越好。
AI.motivation: CRT是伴电学不同步的心衰患者的重要治疗，但部分心电图显示不同步的患者仍无反应。除QRS时限外，去极化序列的可视化与量化可能有助于改善患者筛选和反应预测。
AI.method: 回顾性分析121例接受CRT植入的成人患者，其中反应者93例（女性33%），无反应者28例（女性7%）。收集植入前和植入后即刻心电图，使用通用心-躯干模型的CineECG分析，计算QRS在前后、室间和心尖-基底轴上的去极化路径方向。以6个月随访左室逆重构为终点，采用多因素logistic回归分析空间去极化特征与CRT反应的关系。
AI.result: 植入前去极化序列主要从右室向左室，植入后转变为心尖-基底方向。多因素logistic回归显示，植入前QRS时限、心尖-基底去极化梯度和CRT诱导的QRS缩短独立预测CRT反应；Akaike信息准则表明三者联合预测模型最强。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间和P值。
AI.conclusion: CineECG衍生的去极化梯度反映心室激动序列，CRT后显著改变，且植入前心尖-基底梯度独立预测超声心动图结局，梯度较小与更好的血流动力学反应相关。该指标有望辅助CRT患者筛选，但需前瞻性验证，且摘要未提供具体统计数值。

summary_zh:
目的：心室电学不同步是射血分数降低的心力衰竭中室内传导疾病的标志。尽管心脏再同步治疗（CRT）有效，但一部分心电图（ECG）显示电学不同步的患者仍然无应答。除了QRS时限外，对除极序列的可视化和量化可能有助于改善CRT应答。本研究旨在评估CRT患者中CineECG衍生的除极平均时空等时线轨迹。

方法与结果：在121例接受CRT植入的成人队列中，有93例（33%女性）应答者和28例（7%女性）无应答者。收集CRT植入前和植入后即刻记录的ECG，并使用CineECG模式结合通用心脏/躯干模型进行分析。在心脏解剖结构内，计算了QRS在前后轴、室间轴和心尖-基底轴上的CineECG衍生路径方向。测试了空间除极特征与6个月随访时左心室逆重构的相关性。植入前的除极序列主要从右心室向左心室，CRT植入后，其转变为心尖-基底方向。在多变量逻辑回归中，植入前QRS时限、心尖-基底除极梯度和CRT诱导的QRS缩短独立预测CRT应答。赤池信息准则表明，结合所有三个变量产生了最强的预测模型。

结论：反映心室激动序列的CineECG衍生除极梯度在CRT后发生显著变化，且植入前的心尖-基底梯度独立预测超声心动图结局，梯度越不明显与更好的血流动力学应答相关。

title: Prognostic value of the inflammatory burden index in predicting 1-year mortality in patients undergoing cardiac resynchronization therapy for heart failure.
summary:
BACKGROUND/OBJECTIVES: Heart failure (HF) is one of the leading causes of death and impairs quality of life worldwide. Systemic inflammation has been increasingly recognized as a major contributor to adverse outcomes in patients with heart failure. The Inflammatory Burden Index (IBI), a composite marker integrating C-reactive protein (CRP), neutrophils, and lymphocytes, may offer improved prognostic value over traditional inflammatory markers. This study aimed to evaluate the prognostic significance of IBI in predicting one-year mortality among patients undergoing Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy (CRT).

METHODS: This retrospective observational study included 525 heart failure patients who received CRT between January 2020 and January 2024. Patients were grouped based on 1-year survival status. Continuous variables were compared using Student's t-test or Mann-Whitney U test based on normality assessment, and presented as mean ± SD or median [interquartile range, IQR]. To handle right-skewness and ensure linearity in the logit, inflammatory markers were logarithmically transformed [Log(IBI) and Log(CRP)]. Multivariable logistic regression models were constructed using a standardized baseline clinical model. Incremental prognostic value was evaluated using Integrated Discrimination Improvement (IDI), continuous Net Reclassification Improvement (NRI), and DeLong's test.

RESULTS: Baseline CRP (median [IQR]: 20.90 [11.95-33.00] vs. 6.56 [3.37-13.80] mg/dL, p < 0.001) and IBI (median [IQR]: 81.15 [36.56-230.90] vs. 18.61 [7.76-44.46], p < 0.001) were significantly higher in non-survivors. In multivariable analysis, both Log(IBI) (OR: 1.983; 95% CI: 1.463-2.687; p < 0.001) and Log(CRP) (OR: 3.265; 95% CI: 2.278-4.678; p < 0.001) independently predicted 1-year mortality. Incorporating Log(IBI) or Log(CRP) significantly improved model discrimination over baseline clinical risk (AUC increased from 0.684 to 0.778 and 0.795, respectively; DeLong p < 0.001), yielding substantial IDI (0.0953 and 0.1118, p < 0.001) and continuous NRI (67.1% and 80.6%, p < 0.001) gains. Head-to-head comparison showed comparable discriminative performance between Log(IBI) and Log(CRP) models (DeLong p = 0.307).

CONCLUSIONS: Both Log(IBI) and Log(CRP) are independent predictors of 1-year mortality in HF patients undergoing CRT, offering comparable incremental prognostic utility over standard clinical risk factors. Incorporating these inflammatory biomarkers into routine risk stratification may refine the identification of high-risk candidates.

AI.tldr: 在525例接受CRT的心衰患者中，炎症负荷指数（IBI）和CRP均为1年死亡的独立预测因子，且预测价值相当，均可提升基线临床模型的区分度。
AI.motivation: 心衰患者预后差，系统性炎症是重要不良因素。IBI整合CRP、中性粒细胞和淋巴细胞，可能优于传统炎症标志物，但其在接受CRT患者中的预后价值尚不明确。
AI.method: 回顾性观察研究，纳入2020年1月至2024年1月接受CRT的525例心衰患者，按1年生存状态分组。比较基线资料，对炎症标志物进行对数转换后构建多变量logistic回归模型，评估IBI和CRP对1年死亡的独立预测价值，并通过IDI、连续NRI和DeLong检验评估增量预后价值。
AI.result: 非存活者基线CRP中位数20.90 vs 6.56 mg/dL，IBI中位数81.15 vs 18.61，均显著更高（p<0.001）。多变量分析中，Log(IBI)（OR 1.983，95%CI 1.463-2.687，p<0.001）和Log(CRP)（OR 3.265，95%CI 2.278-4.678，p<0.001）均独立预测1年死亡。加入Log(IBI)或Log(CRP)后AUC从0.684分别升至0.778和0.795（DeLong p<0.001），IDI分别为0.0953和0.1118（p<0.001），连续NRI分别为67.1%和80.6%（p<0.001）。两者区分度相当（DeLong p=0.307）。
AI.conclusion: IBI和CRP均是接受CRT心衰患者1年死亡的独立预测因子，增量预后价值相当。将炎症生物标志物纳入常规风险分层有助于识别高危患者，但本研究为回顾性单中心设计，需前瞻性验证。

summary_zh:
背景/目的：心力衰竭（HF）是全球主要死亡原因之一，并损害生活质量。全身性炎症日益被认为是心力衰竭患者不良结局的主要促成因素。炎症负荷指数（IBI）是一种整合C反应蛋白（CRP）、中性粒细胞和淋巴细胞的复合标志物，可能比传统炎症标志物提供更好的预后价值。本研究旨在评估IBI在接受心脏再同步治疗（CRT）的患者中预测一年死亡率的预后意义。

方法：这项回顾性观察研究纳入了2020年1月至2024年1月期间接受CRT的525例心力衰竭患者。根据1年生存状态对患者进行分组。连续变量根据正态性评估采用Student t检验或Mann-Whitney U检验进行比较，并以均值±标准差或中位数[四分位距，IQR]表示。为处理右偏态并确保logit中的线性，炎症标志物经对数转换[Log(IBI)和Log(CRP)]。使用标准化的基线临床模型构建多变量logistic回归模型。采用综合判别改善指数（IDI）、连续净重分类改善指数（NRI）和DeLong检验评估增量预后价值。

结果：基线CRP（中位数[IQR]：20.90 [11.95-33.00] vs. 6.56 [3.37-13.80] mg/dL，p < 0.001）和IBI（中位数[IQR]：81.15 [36.56-230.90] vs. 18.61 [7.76-44.46]，p < 0.001）在非存活者中显著更高。在多变量分析中，Log(IBI)（OR：1.983；95% CI：1.463-2.687；p < 0.001）和Log(CRP)（OR：3.265；95% CI：2.278-4.678；p < 0.001）均独立预测1年死亡率。将Log(IBI)或Log(CRP)纳入模型后，模型判别能力较基线临床风险显著改善（AUC分别从0.684增至0.778和0.795；DeLong p < 0.001），并带来显著的IDI（0.0953和0.1118，p < 0.001）和连续NRI（67.1%和80.6%，p < 0.001）增益。头对头比较显示，Log(IBI)与Log(CRP)模型的判别性能相当（DeLong p = 0.307）。

结论：Log(IBI)和Log(CRP)均是接受CRT的心力衰竭患者1年死亡率的独立预测因子，在标准临床危险因素基础上提供相当的增量预后效用。将这些炎症生物标志物纳入常规风险分层可能有助于优化高危候选者的识别。

title: A Novel Method for Assessing Left Bundle Branch Capture Using the Bidirectional Conduction Time Difference Between Left Bundle Branch Area Pacing and Coronary Sinus Leads.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Left bundle branch area pacing (LBBAP) is an established conduction system pacing strategy; however, confirming left bundle branch (LBB) capture remains challenging.

OBJECTIVE: We propose a novel method for LBB capture confirmation based on the bidirectional conduction time difference between the LBBAP and coronary sinus (CS) leads.

METHODS: This observational study included 60 patients undergoing de novo left bundle branch-optimized cardiac resynchronization therapy. LBB capture was defined by (1) paced QRS transition, (2) LBB potential with current of injury, or (3) ΔV6 R-wave peak time ≥10 ms. LBBAP-to-CS and CS-to-LBBAP conduction times were measured. ΔLBB-CS ([CS-to-LBBAP] - [LBBAP-to-CS]) was compared between nonselective LBB pacing (NS-LBBP) and left ventricular septal pacing (LVSP).

RESULTS: Among 60 patients (74.7±10.4 years; 42 men), 25 had left bundle branch block and 17 had non-specific intraventricular conduction delay. LBB capture was confirmed in 45 patients (75.0%). LBBAP-to-CS was 114.3±28.0 ms during NS-LBBP (n=43) and 134.2±19.0 ms during LVSP (n=29), whereas CS-to-LBBAP was 143.4±28.5 ms (n=60). ΔLBB-CS was greater during NS-LBBP than LVSP (27.5±9.9 vs. 7.9±7.4 ms, P<0.01). Receiver operating characteristic curve analysis identified a 21.5 ms cutoff for LBB capture (74.4% sensitivity; 100% specificity; area under curve [AUC] 0.95). In patients with baseline LBBB (n=25), a 20.5 ms cutoff for LBB capture yielded 92.9% sensitivity, 100% specificity, and an AUC of 0.99.

CONCLUSION: ΔLBB-CS ≥ 21.5ms may serve as a novel adjunctive marker of LBB capture during LOT-CRT, with greater diagnostic accuracy at a 20.5 ms cutoff in patients with baseline LBBB.

AI.tldr: 在LOT-CRT患者中，LBBAP与CS导联双向传导时间差ΔLBB-CS≥21.5 ms可辅助确认左束支夺获，基线LBBB者以20.5 ms为界诊断准确性更高（AUC 0.99）。
AI.motivation: 左束支区域起搏（LBBAP）已成为传导系统起搏的成熟策略，但术中确认是否真正夺获左束支（LBB）仍较困难，现有标准（起搏QRS形态转变、LBB电位伴损伤电流、V6 R波峰时间差）各有局限，需要新的辅助判断指标。
AI.method: 单中心观察性研究，纳入60例接受新植入左束支优化心脏再同步治疗（LOT-CRT）的患者（74.7±10.4岁，男42例；基线LBBB 25例，非特异性室内传导延迟17例）。LBB夺获定义为起搏QRS形态转变、LBB电位伴损伤电流、或ΔV6 R波峰时间≥10 ms三者之一。测量LBBAP→CS与CS→LBBAP传导时间，计算ΔLBB-CS（CS→LBBAP减去LBBAP→CS），比较非选择性LBB起搏（NS-LBBP）与左室间隔起搏（LVSP）两组间的差异，并用ROC曲线确定诊断界值。
AI.result: LBB夺获确认45例（75.0%）。LBBAP→CS在NS-LBBP组（n=43）为114.3±28.0 ms，LVSP组（n=29）为134.2±19.0 ms；CS→LBBAP为143.4±28.5 ms（n=60）。ΔLBB-CS在NS-LBBP组显著大于LVSP组（27.5±9.9 vs 7.9±7.4 ms，P<0.01）。ROC分析示ΔLBB-CS≥21.5 ms诊断LBB夺获的敏感度74.4%、特异度100%、AUC 0.95；基线LBBB亚组（n=25）以20.5 ms为界，敏感度92.9%、特异度100%、AUC 0.99。
AI.conclusion: ΔLBB-CS可作为LOT-CRT术中确认LBB夺获的新型辅助指标，在基线LBBB患者中诊断准确性更高。该指标为电生理医生提供了除形态学与电位标准外的电学定量补充，但本研究为单中心观察性设计、样本量较小，界值需多中心前瞻性验证后方可常规用于临床决策。

summary_zh:
背景：左束支区域起搏（LBBAP）是一种成熟的传导系统起搏策略；然而，确认左束支（LBB）夺获仍然具有挑战性。

目的：我们提出一种基于LBBAP与冠状窦（CS）导线之间双向传导时间差来确认LBB夺获的新方法。

方法：这项观察性研究纳入了60例接受新植入左束支优化心脏再同步治疗的患者。LBB夺获定义为（1）起搏QRS波形态转变，（2）LBB电位伴损伤电流，或（3）ΔV6 R波峰值时间≥10 ms。测量LBBAP至CS和CS至LBBAP的传导时间。比较非选择性LBB起搏（NS-LBBP）与左心室间隔起搏（LVSP）之间的ΔLBB-CS（[CS至LBBAP] - [LBBAP至CS]）。

结果：在60例患者中（74.7±10.4岁；42例男性），25例有左束支传导阻滞，17例有非特异性心室内传导延迟。45例患者（75.0%）确认LBB夺获。NS-LBBP期间LBBAP至CS为114.3±28.0 ms（n=43），LVSP期间为134.2±19.0 ms（n=29），而CS至LBBAP为143.4±28.5 ms（n=60）。NS-LBBP期间ΔLBB-CS大于LVSP（27.5±9.9 vs. 7.9±7.4 ms，P<0.01）。受试者工作特征曲线分析确定LBB夺获的截断值为21.5 ms（敏感性74.4%；特异性100%；曲线下面积[AUC] 0.95）。在基线LBBB患者中（n=25），LBB夺获的截断值20.5 ms产生92.9%的敏感性、100%的特异性和0.99的AUC。

结论：ΔLBB-CS ≥ 21.5ms可作为LOT-CRT期间LBB夺获的新型辅助标志物，在基线LBBB患者中以20.5 ms为截断值具有更高的诊断准确性。

title: Evaluation of Acute Electrical and Hemodynamic Improvement During Left Bundle-Branch Area Pacing Modalities for Resynchronization Therapy.
summary:
BACKGROUND: While cardiac resynchronization therapy is effective in dyssynchronous heart failure, suboptimal response remains frequent. The acute hemodynamic profile of different left bundle-branch (LBB) area pacing modalities is poorly defined. Moreover, atrioventricular optimization guided by QRS duration (QRSd) may not yield the greatest hemodynamic benefit.

METHODS: Twenty-four patients with heart failure, reduced ejection fraction, and LBB block underwent sequential testing of right ventricular septal pacing, left ventricular septal pacing, nonselective LBB pacing, and selective LBB pacing during cardiac resynchronization therapy implantation in a prospective, within-subject physiological study. At each modality, electrical end points were QRSd and vectorcardiographic QRS area; hemodynamics were assessed with beat-to-beat systolic blood pressure (SBP). The atrioventricular interval producing maximal SBP improvement was compared with that producing the narrowest QRSd.

RESULTS: LBB area pacing modalities significantly reduced QRSd, compared with right ventricular septal pacing (nonselective LBB pacing, 114.0±16.8 milliseconds; selective LBB pacing, 118.4±14.1 milliseconds; left ventricular septal pacing, 124.6±16.0 milliseconds; right ventricular septal pacing, 144.4±27.6 milliseconds; all P<0.01). At the atrioventricular interval that produced maximized SBP improvement, QRSd remained narrower with LBB area pacing than right ventricular septal pacing, and selective LBB pacing provided the greatest hemodynamic improvement (ΔSBP 16.3±5.2 mm Hg), exceeding left ventricular septal pacing (13.5±6.2 mm Hg) and nonselective LBB pacing (12.8±6.3 mm Hg; all P<0.05). Across modalities, the atrioventricular interval that maximized ΔSBP was consistently shorter than that minimizing QRSd (mean difference, 18-29 milliseconds).

CONCLUSIONS: Selective LBB pacing yields the greatest acute hemodynamic benefit, and the hemodynamic-optimal atrioventricular interval is shorter than the electrical-optimal atrioventricular interval, suggesting that modest atrioventricular interval shortening after electrical optimization may better maximize hemodynamics.

REGISTRATION: URL: https://www.clinicaltrials.gov; Unique Identifier: NCT07032064.

AI.tldr: 在24例心衰合并LBBB患者中，选择性左束支起搏的急性血流动力学获益最大（ΔSBP 16.3±5.2 mmHg），且血流动力学最优的AV间期比QRS最窄的AV间期短18-29 ms。
AI.motivation: 心脏再同步治疗（CRT）对非同步性心衰有效，但反应不佳者仍常见；不同左束支（LBB）区域起搏模式的急性血流动力学特征尚不明确，且基于QRS时限（QRSd）的房室（AV）优化可能未带来最大血流动力学获益。
AI.method: 前瞻性、自身对照生理学研究，纳入24例心衰、射血分数降低合并LBBB患者，在CRT植入术中序贯测试右室间隔起搏、左室间隔起搏、非选择性LBB起搏和选择性LBB起搏。电学终点为QRSd和向量心电QRS面积，血流动力学采用逐搏收缩压（SBP）评估；比较产生最大SBP改善的AV间期与产生最窄QRSd的AV间期。
AI.result: 与右室间隔起搏（QRSd 144.4±27.6 ms）相比，各LBB区域起搏模式均显著缩短QRSd（非选择性LBB起搏114.0±16.8 ms、选择性LBB起搏118.4±14.1 ms、左室间隔起搏124.6±16.0 ms，均P<0.01）。在SBP改善最大的AV间期，LBB区域起搏的QRSd仍窄于右室间隔起搏；选择性LBB起搏血流动力学改善最大（ΔSBP 16.3±5.2 mmHg），优于左室间隔起搏（13.5±6.2 mmHg）和非选择性LBB起搏（12.8±6.3 mmHg，均P<0.05）。各模式下，最大化ΔSBP的AV间期均短于最小化QRSd的AV间期（平均差18-29 ms）。
AI.conclusion: 选择性LBB起搏带来最大的急性血流动力学获益；血流动力学最优AV间期短于电学最优AV间期，提示在电学优化后适度缩短AV间期可能更好地最大化血流动力学。该发现对CRT的AV间期优化策略有潜在影响，但样本量小、为急性研究，长期临床获益需进一步验证。

summary_zh:
背景：尽管心脏再同步治疗对非同步性心力衰竭有效，但反应不佳仍很常见。不同左束支（LBB）区域起搏模式的急性血流动力学特征尚不明确。此外，以QRS时限（QRSd）为指导的房室间期优化可能无法带来最大的血流动力学获益。

方法：在这项前瞻性、个体内生理学研究中，24例心力衰竭、射血分数降低且伴左束支传导阻滞的患者在心脏再同步治疗植入术中依次接受了右心室间隔起搏、左心室间隔起搏、非选择性LBB起搏和选择性LBB起搏的测试。每种模式下的电学终点为QRSd和心电向量图QRS面积；血流动力学通过逐搏收缩压（SBP）评估。将产生最大SBP改善的房室间期与产生最窄QRSd的房室间期进行比较。

结果：与右心室间隔起搏相比，LBB区域起搏模式显著缩短了QRSd（非选择性LBB起搏，114.0±16.8毫秒；选择性LBB起搏，118.4±14.1毫秒；左心室间隔起搏，124.6±16.0毫秒；右心室间隔起搏，144.4±27.6毫秒；所有P<0.01）。在产生最大SBP改善的房室间期下，LBB区域起搏的QRSd仍比右心室间隔起搏更窄，且选择性LBB起搏提供了最大的血流动力学改善（ΔSBP 16.3±5.2 mm Hg），超过左心室间隔起搏（13.5±6.2 mm Hg）和非选择性LBB起搏（12.8±6.3 mm Hg；所有P<0.05）。在各模式中，使ΔSBP最大化的房室间期始终短于使QRSd最小化的房室间期（平均差异，18-29毫秒）。

结论：选择性LBB起搏产生最大的急性血流动力学获益，且血流动力学最优的房室间期短于电学最优的房室间期，提示在电学优化后适度缩短房室间期可能更好地最大化血流动力学。
